By incorporating a training-free feasibility operator into the reverse-diffusion sampling loop, CTDF enforces hard constraints for applications such as simulation, legal compliance, and extrapolation. Extensive experiments on large-scale financial datasets demonstrate zero constraint violations and improvement in scarce data utility. CTDF establishes a robust method for generating trustworthy and compliant synthetic data, opening new avenues for rigorous generative modeling and analysis in the financial domain.

</details>


### [255] [A Path-Space Formulation of Prediction in World Models: From a Single Action to Prediction, Planning, and Irreversibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28751)
*Gunn Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在AI世界模型中使用路径空间公式进行预测，将世界模型隐式定义为未来轨迹的概率测度。在有效马尔可夫潜动力学条件下，该路径测度采用Onsager-Machlup形式，使预测、规划和不确定性统一于单一作用泛函。通过分解可逆与不可逆分量并引入熵产生度量，发现在注意力模型中，注意力不对称性随数据不可逆性成比例习得。对称化注意力会抑制熵产生并选择性破坏长程不可逆预测，表明不可逆性可作为预测世界模型的计算资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI世界模型通常将预测建模为单步条件分布的序列，缺乏对轨迹整体概率分布的考量。作者希望建立一种路径空间框架，统一处理预测、规划和不确定性，并揭示不可逆性在预测中的作用。

Method: 1) 将世界模型隐式定义的概率测度形式化为Onsager-Machlup作用泛函；2) 将潜动力学分解为可逆与不可逆分量；3) 从模型rollout中引入熵产生的操作度量；4) 在小规模注意力模型上实验，分析注意力不对称性与数据不可逆性的关系。

Result: 1) 注意力不对称性在训练中习得，且与数据不可逆性成正比；2) 对称化注意力会抑制熵产生；3) 对称化选择性降低长程不可逆动力学的预测能力，但保留弛豫预测能力。

Conclusion: 不可逆性可能是预测世界模型的一种计算资源。未来预测的基本对象应是未来路径的分布而非状态分布。

Abstract: We propose a path-space formulation of prediction in AI world models. Rather than sequences of one-step conditional distributions, we argue that a world model implicitly defines a probability measure over future trajectories. In the local regime where latent dynamics admit an effective Markovian description, this path measure takes the Onsager-Machlup form. Within this framework, prediction (most probable trajectory), planning (constrained optimization), and uncertainty (fluctuations) emerge as operations on a single action functional. We decompose the latent dynamics into reversible and irreversible components and introduce operational measures of entropy production from model rollouts. In controlled small-scale attention-based models, we find that attention asymmetry is acquired during training in proportion to the irreversibility of the data. Symmetrizing the learned attention suppresses entropy production and selectively degrades long-horizon prediction of irreversible dynamics while preserving relaxational prediction. These results suggest that irreversibility may serve as a computational resource for predictive world models. More generally, the fundamental predictive object is a distribution over future paths rather than states.

</details>


### [256] [Hierarchical Decision Making with Structured Policies: A Principled Design via Inverse Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28764)
*Yuexuan Wang,Jingyuan Zhou,Kaidi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于逆向优化的分层RL-OC框架，通过从专家演示中学习下层优化问题的结构，确保下层策略目标与长期任务目标对齐，在资源分配和碰撞规避任务中优于端到端RL、学习增强最优控制及现有分层RL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分层策略中，RL方法难以严格满足约束，OC方法则依赖短视且计算昂贵的公式，亟需一种能够系统整合上层目标抽象与下层结构化决策的框架。

Method: 采用逆向优化方法从专家演示中推断下层优化问题的目标结构，将上层目标抽象与下层决策制定系统地整合为一个分层的RL-OC框架。

Result: 在网络资源分配和连续碰撞规避两类任务中，所提方法在效率和决策质量上持续优于端到端RL、学习增强最优控制及现有分层RL基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过逆向优化指导下层问题结构的设计，能够有效弥合分层RL-OC架构中下层优化目标的短视问题，实现与长期任务目标的对齐。

Abstract: Hierarchical decision-making frameworks are pivotal for addressing complex control tasks, enabling agents to decompose intricate problems into manageable subgoals. Despite their promise, existing hierarchical policies face critical limitations: (i) reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods struggle to guarantee strict constraint satisfaction, and (ii) optimal control (OC)-based approaches often rely on myopic and computationally prohibitive formulations. To reconcile these trade-offs, hierarchical RL-OC architectures have emerged as a promising paradigm. However, the formulation of the lower-level optimization within these frameworks remains underexplored, often relying on heuristic or myopic objectives. In this work, we propose a principled framework that systematically integrates upper-level goal abstraction with structured lower-level decision making. We adopt an inverse optimization approach to inform the structure of the lower-level problem from expert demonstrations, ensuring that the objective of the lower-level policy remains aligned with the overall long-term task goal. To validate the approach, our framework is evaluated on distinct decision making tasks: network-based resource allocation and continuous collision avoidance. Empirical results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines based on end-to-end RL, learning-augmented optimal control, and existing hierarchical RL approaches in both efficiency and decision quality.

</details>


### [257] [Generative Learning as a Tool to Improve Perception of Emotional Body Motion Expressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28769)
*Huakun Liu,Miao Cheng,Xin Wei,Felix Dollack,Victor Schneider,Hideaki Uchiyama,Chia-huei Tseng,Yoshifumi Kitamura,Monica Perusquia-Hernandez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究生成模型能否从基于日本演员的动作捕捉数据中隐式学习情感身体运动表达，而不依赖显式情感-运动指导。基于Transformer的生成模型在13种离散情感标签下生成动作，机器识别准确率22.80%，日本人感知准确率24.91%，并验证了其在情感识别增强、情感运动模式提取及情感强度平滑过渡等任务中的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感身体运动是非语言交流的关键要素，在虚拟现实化身和社交机器人等技术应用中至关重要。然而，由于情感线索的微妙性、个体差异和文化差异，生成准确的情感表达表征具有挑战性。研究者希望探究生成模型能否直接从文化根基的动作捕捉数据中隐式学习情感身体运动，无需显式的情感-运动指导。

Method: 使用49名日本演员的情感表演动作捕捉数据集，训练基于Transformer的生成模型，以13种离散情感标签为条件生成表达性动作。评估从两个角度进行：(1) LSTM分类器评估机器可识别性（准确率22.80%）；(2) 日本评估者进行人类感知研究（准确率24.91%）。此外，评估生成模型在三种实用任务中的效用：增强情感识别模型、提取代表性情感特定运动模式、合成情感强度间的平滑过渡。

Result: 机器识别准确率为22.80%，人类感知准确率为24.91%。生成模型在增强情感识别模型、提取代表性情感特定运动模式以及合成情感强度间平滑过渡等实用任务中展现了有效性。

Conclusion: 研究结果强调了隐式、数据驱动的生成建模在增强情感计算应用以及深化我们对情感表达理解方面的潜力。

Abstract: Emotional body motion expressions are an essential element of non-verbal communication. Effectively conveying these expressions through technology is of utmost importance, for example, with virtual reality avatars and in social robotics. Recent advances in generative models have opened new opportunities for advancing research on emotional body motion learning. However, generating accurate emotional expression representations is challenging, given the subtlety of emotional cues, individual variability, and cultural differences. We investigate whether a generative model can implicitly learn emotional body motions directly from culturally grounded motion-capture data, without explicit emotion-motion guidance. Using a dataset of emotional performances by 49 Japanese actors, we trained a Transformer-based generative model to generate expressive motions conditioned on 13 discrete emotion labels. We evaluate the generated motions from two perspectives: (1) an LSTM-based classifier to assess recognizability by machine observers, achieving a recognition accuracy of 22.80%, and (2) a human perception study with Japanese raters to assess alignment with human affective interpretations, yielding a recognition accuracy of 24.91%. Beyond these, we evaluate the utility of generative modeling for three practical tasks: augmenting emotion recognition models, extracting representative emotion-specific motion patterns, and synthesizing smooth transitions between emotion intensities. Our findings highlight the potential of implicit, data-driven generative modeling to enhance affective computing applications and our understanding of emotion expressions.

</details>


### [258] [On design-unbiased algorithmic Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28795)
*Li-Chun Zhang,Siu-Ming Tam,Luis Sanguiao-Sande,Wesley Yung,Anders Holmberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在缺乏真实数据模型的情况下，机器学习算法（如kNN、随机森林）如何通过基于已知概率抽样设计的方法实现无偏预测和分类，适用于官方统计等重视无偏性的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准ML算法以预测性能（如MSE、F-score）为优化目标，无法直接保证无偏性，而在官方统计等领域无偏性至关重要。因此需要研究在不存在真实数据模型时，如何实现无偏预测或分类。

Method: 基于已知的概率抽样设计（而非假设的分布或模型），研究训练数据的采样方式、算法调优方法以及无偏评估预测性能的条件。

Result: 给出了在有限总体中实现无偏预测/分类的条件，包括训练样本如何从总体中抽取、如何调优算法以达到无偏性，以及如何无偏地评估样本外预测性能。

Conclusion: 基于已知概率设计（而非模型假设）可以实现ML算法的无偏推断，为官方统计等应用提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, such as k-Nearest Neighbours (kNN) or random forest, eschew the ideal of true data models in favour of predictive performance. However, minimising the MSE or F-score cannot lead to unbiasedness directly, which is important in many situations such as official statistics. We study the conditions of algorithmic ML, other than the existence and knowledge of true data models, which lead to unbiased prediction or classification for a given finite population, including how the training data may be sampled from the population, how a trained prediction algorithm can be tuned to achieve unbiased prediction or classification for that population, and how the performance of out-of-sample prediction or classification can be assessed unbiasedly. The inference is based on the known probability design of samples and training sets, rather than any assumed distributions or models.

</details>


### [259] [HARD-KV: Head-Adaptive Regularization for Decoding-time KV Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28831)
*Yuxuan Yang,Feiyang Ren,Bowen Zeng,Dalin Zhang,Jinpeng Chen,Gang Chen,Huan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HARD-KV通过级联缓存层次结构和Logits校准机制，解决了长上下文LLM推理中动态压缩算法与静态系统约束之间的矛盾，在10k+ token场景下实现2倍吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理存在根本性冲突：头部自适应压缩算法（如Top-p采样）通过动态波动的内存预算提供更优精度，但现代推理引擎（如vLLM）要求刚性静态内存模式以利用CUDA Graphs和PagedAttention。现有方法无法弥合这种"静态-动态"不匹配。

Method: 提出HARD-KV统一框架：(1) Cascade Cache层次结构，管理token在密集、稀疏和压缩三层间的生命周期；(2) Logits校准机制，将多样化的重要性指标归一化到统一概率空间，实现跨异构头的一致性Top-p预算分配；(3) 系统级解决方案，将碎片化的动态索引重写为连续物理布局，兼容高性能推理引擎。

Result: 在数学推理基准（AIME, U-Math）上的实验表明，HARD-KV在10k+ token场景下相比静态基线实现了高达2倍的吞吐量提升，同时保持高保真生成质量。

Conclusion: HARD-KV成功桥接了动态选择与刚性系统约束之间的鸿沟，为长上下文LLM推理提供了一种兼顾精度与效率的实用方案。

Abstract: Long-context LLM inference faces a fundamental conflict: head-adaptive compression algorithms (e.g., Top-$p$ nucleus sampling) offer superior accuracy by dynamically fluctuating memory budgets, yet modern inference engines (e.g., vLLM) demand rigid, static memory patterns to leverage CUDA Graphs and PagedAttention. We resolve this ``Static-Dynamic'' mismatch with HARD-KV, a unified framework that that bridges dynamic selection with rigid system constraints. HARD-KV introduces a Cascade Cache hierarchy, managing the token lifecycle across dense, sparse, and condensed tiers. Crucially, we propose a Logits Calibration mechanism that normalizes diverse importance metrics into a unified probability space, enabling consistent Top-$p$ budgeting across heterogeneous heads. To bridge the efficiency gap, we offer a system-level solution, which rewrites fragmented, dynamic indices into contiguous physical layouts compatible with high-performance inference engine. Extensive experiments on math-reasoning benchmarks (AIME, U-Math) verify that HARD-KV achieves up to 2$\times$ throughput improvement over static baselines while maintaining high-fidelity generation in 10k+ token scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/SuDIS-ZJU/HARDInfer.

</details>


### [260] [Active Quantum Kernel Acquisition for Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28833)
*Jian Xu,Delu Zeng,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向近期限量子硬件上高斯过程回归的自适应非均匀测量预算分配方法，通过三种闭合形式的核灵敏度推导与Neyman最小方差分配规则，在四个UCI基准和合成数据上实现10-21%的测试RMSE改进，并将增益推广至多种量子核与下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在近期限量子硬件上，量子核Gram矩阵的每个条目需通过有限次量子线路执行（shots）来估计，传统均匀分配shots的方式效率低下。已有工作针对分类任务提出了非均匀分配方法，但高斯过程回归中后验方差、对数行列式、边际似然等下游量对核误差的耦合比分类更紧密，因而需要专门针对回归任务的灵敏度驱动分配策略。

Method: 推导三种闭合形式的核条目灵敏度：|α_i α_j|（预测权重）、留一法残差、边际似然梯度；基于Neyman最小方差分配规则将shots非均匀分配到各核条目；为防止warm-up阶段灵敏度估计噪声导致过度集中，引入Frobenius范数下界驱动的均匀覆盖floor。在四个UCI基准和两个合成RBF+Bernoulli控制实验上验证，并在ZZ核、Pauli-Z量子核及四种下游任务（贝叶斯求积、异方差回归、超参数学习、多输出Cokriging）上测试迁移性。

Result: 在中等预算范围内，非均匀分配相比均匀分配实现10-21%的测试RMSE改进；在量子原生数据上的ZZ和Pauli-Z量子核中，低预算下获得-13~15%的改进（p<0.05配对检验）；在四个下游任务上增益均可迁移；在UCI特征嵌入ZZ核时增益消失，归因于指数浓度区域中shots分配无优化空间。

Conclusion: 针对高斯过程回归的shot-adaptive分配策略显著优于均匀分配，且增益可跨核类型、跨下游任务迁移。但当数据处于指数浓度区域时，核值区分度不足导致分配策略失效，提示了该方法的适用边界。

Abstract: Quantum kernel estimation on near-term hardware is shot-budgeted: every entry of the kernel Gram matrix is a Bernoulli expectation that must be sampled with a finite number of circuit executions. Recent work on quantum kernel classification has shown that allocating shots non-uniformly across kernel entries, weighted by their downstream task sensitivity, can reduce the shot budget required to reach a target accuracy. We extend this idea to Gaussian process (GP) regression, a setting whose downstream quantities (full-spectrum posterior variance, log-determinant, marginal likelihood) couple to kernel error more tightly than the sign-only outputs of classification. We derive three closed-form pair-level sensitivities predictive coupling $|α_iα_j|$, leave-one-out residual, and marginal-likelihood gradient and plug them into a Neyman-style minimum-variance allocation rule. To prevent catastrophic over-concentration when the warm-up sensitivity estimate is itself noisy, we add a high uniform coverage floor justified by a Frobenius lower bound on the missing-entry perturbation. On four UCI benchmarks and two synthetic RBF + Bernoulli controlled studies, the resulting allocator delivers $10$--$21\%$ test-RMSE improvement over uniform allocation across the moderate-budget regime. The gain transfers (i) to genuine ZZ and Pauli-Z quantum kernels on quantum-natural data ($-13$--$15\%$ at low budget, $p<0.05$ paired) and (ii) to four downstream tasks (Bayesian quadrature, heteroscedastic regression, hyperparameter learning, multi-output Cokriging). On UCI features embedded into a ZZ kernel the gain disappears, consistent with the exponential-concentration regime where shot allocation has nothing to exploit.

</details>


### [261] [Fisher-Routed Mixture of Experts for Federated Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28835)
*Wenhao Yuan,Chenchen Lin,Jian Chen,Jinfeng Xu,Zewei Liu,Edith Cheuk Han Ngai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedFMX框架，通过Fisher路由的混合专家模型解决联邦类增量学习中的容量冲突、灾难性遗忘、数据异构性和类别对齐问题，在多个基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习扩展到类增量学习场景时面临三个独特挑战：1)共享模型过载导致的容量冲突和灾难性遗忘；2)Non-IID数据带来的异构性；3)同步类别不对齐问题。现有方法难以同时应对这些挑战。

Method: 提出FedFMX框架，核心创新包括：1)Fisher路由专家评分(FRES)模块，基于Fisher信息稳定性代价和梯度塑性增益估计专家重要性；2)自适应专家选择(AES)模块，通过量化边际贡献确定专家子集；3)路由感知正则化(RAR)实现负载均衡和高效联邦训练。

Result: 理论证明了O(T^{-1})的收敛速率，在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明FedFMX优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过自适应专家特化的路由机制，FedFMX有效缓解了联邦类增量学习中的容量冲突、遗忘和异构性问题，为分布式增量学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) emerged as a promising distributed machine learning paradigm. However, extending FL to the class incremental learning scenarios introduces unique challenges: 1) Capacity conflict and catastrophic forgetting from the shared model overloading, 2) Heterogeneity from Non-Independent and Identically Distributed (Non-IID) data, and 3) Synchronized class misalignment. In this paper, we propose \textbf{F}isher-Routed \textbf{M}i\textbf{X}ture of Experts for \textbf{Fed}erated Class-Incremental Learning (\textsc{FedFMX}), a novel framework to address these challenges via adaptive expert specialization across clients. The crucial insight is to route each sample to an expert subset that jointly optimizes knowledge acquisition and retention. Specifically, we introduce a Fisher-Routed Expert Scoring (FRES) module to estimate expert importance via Fisher-based stability cost and gradient-based plasticity gain. Then, we design an Adaptive Expert Selection (AES) module by quantifying marginal contributions for adaptive expert subset determination. Finally, by the routing-aware regularization (RAR), we achieve load balance and efficient FL training. We theoretically prove the $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1})$ convergence rate. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks compared with state-of-the-art methods demonstrate the superiority of \textsc{FedFMX}.

</details>


### [262] [The Contagion Tensor: A Framework for Measuring Output-Distribution Coupling in Multi-Agent LLM Systems -- and Auditing the Claims It Enables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28839)
*Zewen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Contagion Tensor测量框架和CAF指标族，通过模拟和真实API实验验证了多模态、多agent、多时间步下LLM输出分布的耦合效应，发现图像条件可导致超线性耦合（CAF=1.40→0.87消融后坍塌），并建立了一套可迁移的消融协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个定量、可证伪的测量框架来量化LLM输出分布在跨模态、跨agent和跨时间步维度上的耦合程度，难以区分真实耦合与设计伪影。

Method: 定义Contagion Tensor张量框架，导出CAF（Coupling Amplification Factor）比率指标族（CAF = E[T_condition] / E[T_baseline]），采用bootstrap置信区间。设计2×2×2块正交模拟，含模态特异性消融，并在DeepSeek-Chat和GPT-4o-mini上做真实API验证。

Result: 模拟中图像条件CAF=1.40（超线性），禁用图像扰动后坍塌至0.87（次线性），偏移-0.53，文本条件无影响。真实API中：统一persona下CAF≈1.0，多样persona驱动收敛至0.88；GPT-4o-mini文本CAF=1.02 vs 图像CAF=1.72，delta=+0.70，验证了模拟预测。

Conclusion: 贡献包括：(1) 一个使输出分布耦合可定量证伪的测量工具；(2) 一个可迁移的消融协议，任何模块化多agent模拟器均可采用以区分真实耦合与设计伪影。

Abstract: We introduce the Contagion Tensor, a measurement framework for quantifying how large language model (LLM) output distributions couple across modalities, agents, and time steps. From the tensor we derive the Coupling Amplification Factor (CAF), a family of ratio-based metrics sharing the form CAF = E[T_condition] / E[T_baseline], providing unitless, baseline-referenced measurement with bootstrap confidence intervals. We instantiate CAF in four variants and evaluate the strongest in a complete 2x2x2 block-orthogonal simulation design with modality-specific ablation. The ablation reveals that an apparent image-condition super-linear effect (CAF = 1.40) collapses to sub-linear (CAF = 0.87) when the image perturbation module is disabled, a shift of -0.53 with zero effect on text conditions. We supplement with real-API experiments across two model families: DeepSeek-Chat (R=30) and GPT-4o-mini (R=15, real vision). Under uniform personas, text-only communication produces CAF approx 1.0 in both models. Diverse personas drive convergence (CAF = 0.88). A within-model comparison on GPT-4o-mini reveals: C3 (text) CAF = 1.02 vs. C5 (real vision, R=30) CAF = 1.72 [1.700, 1.733], delta = +0.70, validating the simulation's super-linear image-condition prediction. Of 11 conditions, 5 have been tested on real APIs and 6 remain unverified. Our contribution is two-layered: (1) a measurement instrument that makes output-distribution coupling quantitatively falsifiable; and (2) a transferable ablation protocol that any modular multi-agent simulator can adopt to distinguish genuine coupling from design artifacts.

</details>


### [263] [Analysis of Adam Algorithms for Stochastic Dynamic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28879)
*Xin Zheng,Yifei Jin,Lei Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了Adam算法在时变非平稳随机系统中的通用理论，通过引入新分析技术和随机Lyapunov函数，在非平稳、非独立同分布数据条件下推导出参数跟踪和输出预测误差界，为超参数选择提供了理论指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Adam类算法的理论分析主要针对时不变模型参数且依赖独立同分布数据假设，这在时变非平稳系统中往往不成立。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，建立Adam在时变非平稳随机系统中的通用理论。

Method: 引入新分析技术处理Adam耦合的一阶和二阶矩递归所诱导的非平稳相依随机矩阵乘积；构造融合两种矩动力学的新型随机Lyapunov函数；在允许非平稳相依数据的随机激励条件下推导误差界。

Result: 推导出参数跟踪和输出预测误差的显式界，量化了步长、一阶和二阶动量参数、梯度噪声和参数漂移的影响；通过合成和真实数据实验验证了理论和设计指南。

Conclusion: 所推导的误差界不仅为Adam在时变非平稳系统中的性能提供了理论保证，还为超参数选择提供了指导原则。

Abstract: The adaptive moment estimation algorithm, known as Adam, is widely used in modern machine learning, owing to its low per-iteration complexity and strong empirical performance. Despite its prevalent use, the theoretical foundation of Adam remains largely unexplored for time-varying and nonstationary systems. In fact, the existing theoretical analyses of Adam-type algorithms are primarily concerned with time-invariant model parameters and explicitly or implicitly rely on independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) data assumptions, under which the learning taskcan be formulated as minimizing a fixed expected objective with a static minimizer. However, such assumptions are often violated in time-varying and nonstationary systems, thereby calling for a theoretical investigation beyond the conventional yet idealized i.i.d. setting. The main objective of this paper is to solve this challenging problem by establishing a general theory of Adam for time-varying and nonstationary stochastic systems. We will introduce some new techniques for analyzing the products of nonstationary and dependent random matrices induced by Adam's coupled first- and second-moment recursions, and will construct a new stochastic Lyapunov function that blends these two moment dynamics. Under a stochastic excitation condition that allows nonstationary and dependent data, we will derive both parameter tracking and output prediction error bounds explicitly, quantifying the effects of stepsize, first- and second-momentum parameters, gradient noise and parameter drift. These bounds not only provide guarantees for Adam performance, but also provide guidelines for hyperparameter selection. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world data validate our theory and design guidelines.

</details>


### [264] [An Integrated Machine Learning and Hierarchical Variance Decomposition Pipeline for Student Performance Prediction and Metacognitive Calibration on Multi-Signal Telemetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28881)
*Gurdeep Singh Virdee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一行为预测与校准分析管道（UBP-CAP），集成了LightGBM分类器与SHAP解释、校准度量和混合效应模型，并引入预测-解释分歧指数（PEDI），在27名学生1195条交互记录上验证了该框架对表现预测和元认知校准的统一分析能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究将学生表现预测、校准误差计算和方差分解作为独立管道处理，缺乏统一的分析框架，无法实现整体解释。

Method: 提出UBP-CAP框架，包含三个模块：(1) LightGBM分类器与SHAP进行正确性预测；(2) ECE、MCE、Brier分数分解评估校准；(3) 交叉随机截距GLMM分解校准偏差。并引入PEDI量化预测与解释特征画像的结构差异。

Result: 在1195条交互记录上，Logistic回归AUC-ROC=0.903优于LightGBM的0.878；学生朴素ECE=0.109显著高于模型ECE=0.068；GLMM的ICC学生=0.123，表明校准是情境性而非特质性；PEDIcos=0.081（p=0.327），预测与解释在共享行为特征上结构一致。

Conclusion: UBP-CAP框架能有效统一预测与校准分析，揭示了学生元认知校准的系统性偏差及其情境依赖性，PEDI为量化模型预测与解释的一致性提供了新指标。

Abstract: Predicting student performance and characterizing metacognitive calibration are essential for personalization in intelligent tutoring systems. Prior research treats performance prediction, calibration error calculation, and variance decomposition as separate pipelines, preventing unified interpretation. I propose the Unified Behavioral Prediction and Calibration Analysis Pipeline (UBP-CAP), an integrated framework processing student pre-execution behavioral telemetry through three linked modules: (1) a LightGBM classifier with SHAP for binary correctness prediction, (2) formal calibration metrics (ECE, MCE, and Brier score decomposition) to evaluate metacognitive alignment, and (3) a crossed Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Model (GLMM) for decomposing calibration deviations. I introduce the Predictive-Explanatory Divergence Index (PEDI), which quantifies structural divergence between predictive and explanatory feature profiles. Evaluated on 1,195 interaction records (27 students, 45 tasks), Logistic Regression achieves AUC-ROC = 0.903, outperforming LightGBM (0.878). Student naive ECE (0.109) significantly exceeds model ECE (0.068), confirming systematic miscalibration. The crossed GLMM yields ICCStudent = 0.123, showing calibration is situational rather than dispositional. PEDIcos = 0.081 (p = 0.327) indicates structural alignment between prediction and explanation on shared behavioral features.

</details>


### [265] [MALOQ: Massively Accelerated Learning of Operators for Quantum Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28911)
*Manasa Kaniselvan,Alexander Maeder,Denghui Lu,Alexandros Nikolaos Ziogas,Mathieu Luisier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍MALOQ（大规模加速量子输运算子学习），一个基于SO(2)-等变架构的ML框架，用于预测DFT哈密顿量/密度矩阵，支持从几个到10万原子的系统、大基组和多种元素。通过自定义数据处理核和边级原子图分布，在最大分子哈密顿数据集上训练，相比分子级分布式框架每轮训练时间减少30%以上，并在Alps超算上实现3000-12000原子的可扩展训练与推理（192/256 GPUs）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DFT计算对于大规模系统（数万原子、大基组）计算成本过高，亟需一种能够以显著降低的计算代价准确预测电子结构算子的ML方法，从而将电子结构计算扩展到以前无法实现的尺度。

Method: 基于SO(2)-等变的骨干架构，设计(i)自定义数据处理内核以处理高秩哈密顿矩阵数据，(ii)可扩展的边级分布式原子图策略，实现任意大小材料图的推理。

Result: 在最大分子哈密顿数据集上，相比分子级分布式框架每轮训练时间减少30%以上；在Alps超算上成功实现3000-12000原子系统的可扩展训练（192 GPUs）和推理（256 GPUs）。

Conclusion: MALOQ能够高效训练和推理大规模电子结构矩阵，支持从少量原子到10万原子、多种元素和大基组的系统，为大规模量子输运模拟提供了可行的ML解决方案。

Abstract: Machine-learned (ML) operator models can be trained to predict density functional theory (DFT) Hamiltonian/density matrices at significantly reduced computational cost, thus extending electronic-structure calculations to previously unfeasible scales. Here, we introduce MALOQ (Massively Accelerated Learning of Operators for Quantum Transport), an application built to train on and predict electronic-structure matrices for systems made of few to 100k atoms, described by large basis sets, and covering a wide range of atomic elements. Based on a state-of-the-art, SO(2)-equivariant backbone architecture, MALOQ provides (i) custom data-processing kernels to handle high-rank Hamiltonian matrix data and (ii) a scalable edge-wise distribution of atomic graph(s). Trained on the largest molecular Hamiltonian datasets available today, it reduces time-per-epoch by over 30% compared to a molecule-wise-distributed framework, and enables inference on material graphs of arbitrary size. We demonstrate scalable training and inference for 3,000-12,000 atoms on the Alps supercomputer, up to 192 GPUs and 256 GPUs, respectively.

</details>


### [266] [ML-Powered LDAP Reconnaissance Detection using Weak Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28917)
*Shaefer Drew,Edward Raff,Michael Brautbar,Yaron Zinar,Benjamin Malmberg,Dor Agron,Sagi Sheinfeld,Avraham Kama,Asaf Romano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种基于机器学习的方法检测LDAP侦察行为：一个利用弱监督学习的分类器用于判别恶意LDAP查询，另一个基于统计假设检验挖掘恶意查询签名。分类器在保留集上达到65%真阳性率，挖掘的签名在现场精确率为81.48%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LDAP协议默认允许所有用户读取Active Directory数据，攻击者常利用它在初始入侵阶段进行侦察。现有方法难以大规模、低成本地检测此类行为，故需自动化检测框架以在侦察阶段早期捕获威胁。

Method: 方法一：通过将LDAP查询与端点检测关联，利用弱监督（weak supervision）自动标注大规模数据集，训练ML分类器区分恶意/良性查询。方法二：在分类器基础上，采用严格的统计假设检验框架挖掘新的恶意LDAP查询签名。

Result: 分类器在保留集上达到65%真阳性率（TPR），同时控制了误报率；签名挖掘方法在现场环境中的字段精确率达到81.48%（经CrowdStrike MDR团队验证）。

Conclusion: 弱监督方法虽不及人工标注精确，但通过大规模自动化语料构建降低了成本和时间，在实际场景中更为可行。两种方法均达到了性能基准，可有效检测LDAP侦察行为。

Abstract: Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) is a protocol that allows users to query and modify Active Directory (AD) data. By default, all users have read access to all AD data through LDAP, making it a common initial tool for reconnaissance when a threat actor first compromises an identity. To capture threat actors early in the reconnaissance phase, we developed two machine learning frameworks to detect LDAP reconnaissance: an ML classifier to predict malicious LDAP queries and an ML-based data-mining method to extract malicious query signatures. By correlating LDAP queries with endpoint detections, the first framework uses weak supervision to label a massive dataset and classify LDAP queries as malicious or benign. For immediate deployment, a second technique was developed on top of this approach to employ a rigorous statistical hypothesis-testing framework for mining novel, malicious LDAP signatures. While this weakly supervised approach is limited compared with manual human labeling, it is more practical for this use case because it leverages large-scale automated corpus construction, reducing costs and time. Ultimately, both the LDAP classifier and the ML-based LDAP signature mining method achieved performance benchmarks, with the classifier achieving up to a 65\% True Positive Rate (TPR) on the holdout set while limiting false positives, and mined signatures demonstrating 81.48\% field precision with CrowdStrike's Managed Detection and Response team.

</details>


### [267] [Dead-Direction Conditioners: Gauge-Equivariant Preconditioning for Deep Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29176)
*Tejas Pradeep Shirodkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DDC（Dead-Direction Conditioner），通过将优化器提升为G-等变优化器，使其轨迹保持在参数对称商空间上，从而避免Adam等优化器因对称性漂移导致的损失景观模糊问题。实验表明，DDCAdam在语言模型上抵抗过训练崩溃，在视觉Transformer上达到更低验证损失，DDCMuon在深度网络上实现更优的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络的损失函数对参数存在连续对称性（如logit平移、ReLU重缩放、LayerNorm缩放、注意力头旋转等），而Adam的逐坐标预条件器会沿对称轨道漂移，使优化轨迹偏离商空间，模糊了奇异学习率在商空间中可读的结构信息。

Method: 构建DDC（Dead-Direction Conditioner），在G-不变度量的轨道分解中对优化器状态进行条件化，使轨迹保持为商空间Θ̄=Θ/G上的预条件梯度流。该方法为四种架构规范（交叉熵平移、ReLU/SwiGLU重缩放、LayerNorm/RMSNorm缩放、与RoPE匹配的每头O(d_head)注意力旋转）构建了精确等变的Adam基优化器，并与Muon基优化器通过规范等变正交化器组合。

Result: 语言模型超越拟合点后，DDCAdam保持验证-训练损失差0.67（AdamW为5.88），在65个逐层可观测单元中32个读取到死方向率（AdamW仅7个）。从头训练的视觉Transformer验证损失1.71（AdamW为2.12），且压缩了AdamW保留的冗余前馈容量。DDCMuon在深度24网络中10/11种子达到groking（普通Muon从未达到）。

Conclusion: 将网络的规范对称性构建到优化器中，能够锐化优化器找到的最小值，并使该最小值的几何结构成为轨迹可测量的量。

Abstract: A deep network's loss is invariant to continuous symmetries of its parameters: the logit shift, the ReLU rescaling, the LayerNorm scale, the per-head attention rotation. Adam's per-coordinate preconditioner drifts along each symmetry orbit, which pulls the trajectory off the symmetry quotient where the optimization lives and blurs the singular-learning rate the quotient makes readable. We build DDC, a Dead-Direction Conditioner that lifts a base optimizer into a $G$-equivariant one: it conditions the optimizer's state in the orbit decomposition of a $G$-invariant metric, so the trajectory stays a preconditioned gradient flow on the quotient $\barΘ= Θ/G$. The construction carries four architectural gauges (cross-entropy shift, ReLU and SwiGLU rescaling, LayerNorm and RMSNorm scale, and a per-head $O(d_{\rm head})$ attention rotation matched to RoPE), proves exactly equivariant on an Adam base, and composes with a Muon base through a gauge-equivariant orthogonaliser. Respecting the symmetry changes both the minimum the optimizer reaches and what it leaves measurable there. On a language model trained past the point of fit, DDCAdam resists the over-training collapse AdamW falls into, holding a validation-train loss gap of 0.67 against 5.88, and reads the dead-direction rate in 32 of 65 layer-by-observable cells where AdamW reads it in 7. A vision transformer trained from scratch reaches lower validation loss (1.71 against 2.12) while compressing spare feed-forward capacity a matched AdamW leaves intact. On a Muon base, where the rotation gauge composes exactly, DDCMuon groks ten of eleven seeds at depth 24 that a plain Muon never reaches. Built into the optimizer, a network's gauge symmetry sharpens the minimum it finds and turns that minimum's geometry into something the trajectory can measure.

</details>


### [268] [Towards Improved Anomaly Detection for Cloud Cybersecurity via Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28923)
*Manu Nandan,TJ Jaymes,Michael Brautbar,Edward Raff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于图神经网络的自监督学习方法，应用于AWS CloudTrail日志以检测云安全威胁。该方法为每个事件生成异常分数，并动态适应组织变化，无需周期性重训练。在五个组织的实验中，该方法将警报量从传统方法的数千条/小时降低到约1条/小时，但研究仅限于标记事件，无法估计假阴性率，属于实际部署研究而非完全验证的检测系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于云基础设施依赖增加，检测云安全威胁变得必要。传统基于启发式或异常检测的自动化威胁检测方法由于静态特性导致高误报率，亟需一种能够动态适应并降低误报的检测方法。

Method: 采用图神经网络的自监督学习方法，应用于AWS CloudTrail日志。模型为每个事件生成异常分数，并能够动态适应组织变化而无需周期性重训练。

Result: 在五个组织的实验中，该方法在几乎所有情况下生成的警报量远少于领域专家规则基线，将警报量从传统方法的数千条/小时降低到约1条/小时。但评估仅覆盖被标记事件，无法从当前数据估计假阴性率。

Conclusion: 该方法作为实际部署研究展示了实时约束下的洞见，但并非完全验证的检测系统。未来工作包括讨论局限性以及将方法扩展到其他云环境的要求。

Abstract: Detecting security threats in an organization's cloud computing environment has become necessary due to the increased reliance on cloud infrastructure. Logging of all cloud computing events enables investigation into any incidents after they are detected. Automated detection of threats using the logs based on heuristics or anomaly detection could result in a high false positive rate due to its relatively static nature. In this article, we present an industrial case study of a self-supervised learning method using graph neural networks applied to AWS CloudTrail logs to surface suspicious events for analyst review. The model produces an anomaly score for each event and dynamically adapts to changes in the organization without requiring periodic retraining. Based on our experiments across five organizations, the proposed model produced substantially fewer alerts than a domain expert rule-based baseline in almost all cases, reducing alert volumes to approximately 1 per hour from thousands generated by traditional methods. We note that this evaluation covers only flagged events, and false negatives cannot be estimated from the current data; findings should therefore be interpreted as a practical deployment study offering insights into real-world constraints rather than a fully validated detection system. We discuss these limitations and the requirements for extending the approach to other cloud environments as future work.

</details>


### [269] [Optimizer Memory Makes Shuffle Order a First-Order Source of Fine-Tuning Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29554)
*John Sweeney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，在微调语言模型时，数据顺序（shuffle order）带来的噪声比无记忆优化器预测的更大。固定时钟优化器（如AdamW）的动量缓冲区等状态随步索引而非学习率缩放时间步进，导致相等多重集（equal multiset）的局部对比从O(η²)变为O(η)量级。通过 lifted-state 展开和分析，作者给出了无需拟合的噪声大小估计，并提供了顺序噪声误差条、位置归因权重和种子预算准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示固定时钟优化器（如AdamW）中数据顺序噪声被低估的问题，并量化其影响，为微调实验提供可靠的统计方法和种子预算准则。

Method: 通过 lifted-state 展开分析固定时钟优化器的端点权重效应；采用 bitwise-deterministic replay 隔离机制；推导闭式渐近顺序方差下界（无拟合系数）；进行阶数分析（O(η) vs O(η²)）。

Result: 固定时钟优化器（AdamW、固定β动量）的相等多重集对比噪声为O(η)量级，而非O(η²)；顺序方差斜率：AdamW 1.83，固定β动量 2.00，SGD 4.00；冻结预条件器的AdamW有闭式方差下界。

Conclusion: 固定时钟优化器的顺序噪声是微调A/B比较中不可忽略的来源，单个种子即可翻转比较结果；提供的工具（误差条、归因权重、种子预算）可帮助研究者更可靠地设计微调实验。

Abstract: Shuffle order can be a larger source of fine-tuning noise than a memoryless analysis predicts: fixed-clock optimizer memory makes local equal-multiset contrasts first order in the learning rate rather than second order, and the resulting order channel can be large enough for a single seed to flip a close A/B comparison. We isolate this mechanism and derive a fit-free way to size the noise it produces. For a memoryless optimizer, reordering an equal multiset has no first-order endpoint term; the leading local contrast is the $O(η^2)$ gradient bracket. Fixed-clock optimizers such as AdamW are different. Their moment buffers, preconditioner state, and de-biasing counters advance with the step index rather than with the learning-rate-scaled time $τ=ηk$, so the same gradient can receive a position-dependent endpoint weight. For any fixed finite measurement window, a lifted-state expansion gives an $O(η)$ equal-multiset contrast whenever the first-order replay coefficient is nonzero, while regular and clock-matched controls remain $O(η^2)$; a bare fixed-$β$ momentum buffer is already enough. A bitwise-deterministic replay from one warmed optimizer state isolates the mechanism, giving order-variance slopes 1.83 for AdamW, 2.00 for fixed-$β$ momentum, and 4.00 for SGD; matching the memory clock to $τ$ restores the regular exponent. For AdamW with a frozen preconditioner, the same impulse-weight kernel gives a closed-form asymptotic order-variance floor after the local potentials are measured, with no fitted coefficients. The result is local to the measurement window (independent reshuffling can average the channel across windows), but it yields order-noise error bars, positional attribution weights, and a seed-budget criterion for fine-tuning comparisons.

</details>


### [270] [Multi-Agent Routing as Set-Valued Prediction: A WildChat Benchmark and Cost-Aware Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28925)
*Ananto Nayan Bala,Faisal Muhammad Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于WildChat的多智能体路由基准，包含3,000条提示和12个智能体目录，并设计了涵盖精确率、召回率、F1等集合级指标以及延迟和成本模拟的评估协议。实验表明，监督式路由器显著优于最近邻和零样本LLM方法，其中微调编码器在无约束设置下表现最佳，线性多标签模型提供最强实用基线，加权路由层在约束设置中有效提升效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言提示下的工具和智能体路由本质上是一个集合预测问题，单个查询可能触发多个智能体，而过度选择会增加执行成本。现有研究缺乏针对固定智能体目录的多标签路由基准和标准化评估协议。

Method: 从WildChat衍生出3,000条提示，基于12个固定智能体目录，采用AI辅助启发式标注和重平衡处理。评估协议包括集合级指标（精确率、召回率、F1、Jaccard、精确匹配）、延迟、能力覆盖仿真以及基于序数成本层级的约束加权路由设置。对比方法涵盖最近邻匹配、线性多标签分类、依赖感知基线、微调编码器、确定性加权后评分（WAR）和零样本LLM基线。

Result: 监督式路由器显著优于最近邻和零样本LLM路由。微调编码器在无约束集合准确率方面最强，线性多标签模型提供最强实用基线。在约束设置下，加权路由层在强监督评分器上应用时提升效用，Encoder+WAR组合增益最大。

Conclusion: 该基准和评估协议支持在固定目录的多智能体路由中可重复研究准确率-成本权衡。

Abstract: Tool and agent routing from natural-language prompts is naturally a set-valued prediction problem: a single query may require multiple agents, while over-selection increases execution cost. The benchmark introduced here is derived from WildChat and contains 3,000 prompts over a fixed 12-agent catalog, with AI-assisted heuristic labels under a fixed schema and controlled rebalancing for multi-label evaluation. The evaluation protocol combines set-level metrics (Precision, Recall, F1, Jaccard, and Exact Match), latency, an execution-oriented capability-coverage simulation, and a constrained weighted-routing setting based on ordinal agent-cost tiers. Compared methods include nearest-neighbor matching, linear multilabel classification, dependency-aware baselines, a fine-tuned encoder, deterministic weighted post-scoring via Weighted Agent Routing (WAR), and a zero-shot LLM baseline. Results show that supervised routers substantially outperform nearest-neighbor and zero-shot LLM routing. The fine-tuned encoder achieves the strongest unconstrained set accuracy, while the linear multilabel model provides the strongest practical baseline. In the constrained setting, the weighted routing layer improves utility when applied on top of strong supervised scorers, with the largest gain observed for Encoder+WAR. Overall, the benchmark and evaluation protocol support reproducible study of accuracy-cost trade-offs in fixed-catalog multi-agent routing.

</details>


### [271] [How AI settled the complexity of the oldest SGD algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29593)
*Michał Dereziński,Xiaoyu Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文讲述了Kaczmarz算法（随机梯度下降的前身）的最坏情况复杂度如何通过现代AI模型（如ChatGPT和Gemini）的协助被发现，并记录了这一研究过程的故事。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索Kaczmarz算法在最坏情况下的计算复杂度，这是一个自1937年算法提出以来尚未被完全解决的理论问题。

Method: 利用现代AI模型（ChatGPT和Gemini）协助发现Kaczmarz算法的最坏情况复杂度，结合理论分析与AI辅助推理。

Result: 成功发现了Kaczmarz算法的最坏情况复杂度，这一发现得益于AI模型的参与和协助。

Conclusion: AI模型可以辅助人类解决经典的理论计算机科学问题，展示了人机协作在理论发现中的潜力。

Abstract: In 1937, Stefan Kaczmarz proposed a simple algorithm for solving systems of linear equations. This algorithm turned out to be the earliest known example of stochastic gradient descent, a ubiquitous computing paradigm that drives the training of modern AI models such as ChatGPT and Gemini. Now, those AI models have joined forces to discover the worst-case complexity of the Kaczmarz algorithm. This paper tells the story of how it happened.

</details>


### [272] [DLR: Zero-Inference-Cost Latent Residuals for Low-Rank Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28932)
*Dong Wang,Wenwu Tang,Yun Cheng,Olga Saukh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Duplicated Latent Residual (DLR)方法，通过在低秩预训练中注入可折叠的固定结构化残差来提升性能，训练后可无损吸收回低秩矩阵，不增加部署成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型预训练成本极高，低秩预训练虽能减少参数量和FLOPs但质量落后于全秩训练，需要一种能在保持低秩效率的同时提升质量的方法。

Method: 在标准低秩输出Bz上添加固定结构化残差 alpha/sqrt(K) * Expand_K(z)，其中每个潜在坐标被复制K=ceil(d_out/r)次；训练后通过闭式解B* = B + alpha/sqrt(K) R^T吸收回上投影矩阵，不增加部署参数。

Result: 在60M到7B参数的LLaMA模型上，DLR在多数设置下提升了C4验证集困惑度，130M以上效果最明显；微调后折叠检查点可干净迁移到标准基准任务。

Conclusion: DLR是一种无参数、可折叠的即插即用模块，能有效提升低秩预训练质量，且不牺牲部署效率。

Abstract: Large language models have driven recent progress in language and multimodal AI, yet pre-training them at scale is prohibitively expensive. Low-rank pre-training, which factorizes each weight matrix into a rank-r product to reduce both parameters and FLOPs, is a promising response but typically lags full-rank training in quality. We propose Duplicated Latent Residual (DLR), a training-only, parameter-free, foldable plug-in for low-rank pre-training. DLR augments the standard low-rank output Bz with a fixed structured residual alpha/sqrt(K) * Expand_K(z) that replicates each latent coordinate K = ceil(d_out/r) times across the output. With alpha fixed, DLR adds zero learnable parameters per layer; after training, it is absorbed into the up-projection in closed form, B* = B + alpha/sqrt(K) R^T, so deployment parameter count, FLOPs and memory match the underlying low-rank backbone exactly. Across LLaMA models from 60M to 7B parameters, DLR strengthens low-rank pre-training on C4 validation perplexity in most settings, with the clearest gains at 130M and above; folded checkpoints transfer cleanly to supervised fine-tuning on standard benchmarks.

</details>


### [273] [Decision-Value Attribution in Predict-then-Optimize Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29878)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Alice E. Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出决策价值归因(DVA)框架，基于Shapley值将预测-优化管道的下游决策价值归因到信息源、优化参数或两者组合，实验表明预测解释不能简单替代操作价值归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准解释方法解释的是预测本身而非预测所引发的决策，但预测变化与决策变化之间存在非线性关系：大幅预测变化可能不改变决策，小幅变化却可能改变决策及其实现价值，因此需要直接归因下游决策价值的方法。

Method: 提出Decision Value Attribution (DVA)框架，基于Shapley值定义合作博弈，支付函数为下游决策价值。包含三个变体：InfoDVA归因特征、DesignDVA归因配置参数、Decision-Value Interactions (DVI)量化信息与设计的联合价值。进一步区分post-DVA（用实际结果评估决策）和pre-DVA（用模型预测评估决策）。

Result: 在电力储能套利和紧急医疗服务覆盖的案例研究中，发现预测解释不能作为操作价值的良好代理，DVA能够指导针对性的信息-控制干预，优化配置决定了预测信息的决策相关性。

Conclusion: 归因应以操作目标单位表示，分解相对于基线的得失；DVA可作为判断模型操作信念与实际表现是否一致的决策级诊断工具。

Abstract: Predictive models are increasingly embedded in operational decision-making, yet standard explanation methods typically explain forecasts rather than the decisions those forecasts induce. This distinction is important in predict-then-optimize systems: large forecast changes may leave the optimizer's action unchanged, while small changes can alter the selected decision and its realized value. We propose Decision Value Attribution (DVA), a Shapley-based framework for attributing the value of a fixed prediction--optimization pipeline. The framework defines cooperative games whose payoff is the downstream decision value, allowing the players to be information sources, optimization or design parameters, or both. We present three variants: InfoDVA attributes value to features, DesignDVA attributes value to operational configurations, and Decision-Value Interactions (DVI) quantifies how information and design jointly create value. We further distinguish post-DVA, which evaluates decisions using realized outcomes, from pre-DVA, which evaluates decisions under the model's full prediction. This separation turns attribution into a decision-level diagnostic of whether the model's operational beliefs align with realized performance. The resulting attributions are expressed in the units of the operational objective and decompose the gain or loss relative to a baseline. Case studies in electricity storage arbitrage and emergency medical service coverage show that predictive explanations can be poor proxies for operational value, that DVA can guide targeted information-control interventions, and that optimization configurations determine when predictive information is decision-relevant.

</details>


### [274] [ReGuide: From Test-Time Guidance to Self-Improving Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28939)
*Tzu-Hsiang Lin,Srinivas Shakkottai,Dileep Kalathil,P. R. Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReGuide 是一种自改进框架，通过将指导性 rollout 视为可复用的在线恢复数据来提升行为克隆扩散策略的性能，在多个机器人操作任务上取得了 1.3-7.7 倍的成功率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆扩散策略虽然表达能力强大，但容易受到协变量偏移的影响：与演示状态的微小偏差可能累积导致任务失败。现有方法要么通过专家修正或合成增强来扩展训练分布（成本高或依赖假设），要么在测试时用学到的模型引导冻结策略（丢弃了修正轨迹），缺乏高效利用纠正数据的方法。

Method: 提出 ReGuide 框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 阶段条件引导（PCG），构建阶段特定的潜在目标，仅在漂移但可恢复的区域施加引导，通过估计的干净动作匹配动力学模型的训练分布；(2) 两种吸收策略：ReGuide-FT（对当前检查点微调）和 ReGuide-FS（在增强数据集上从头训练），两者可组合迭代。

Result: 在 Robomimic Can、Square、Transport 和 Tool Hang 任务上，ReGuide 将基础策略的成功率提升了 1.3-7.7 倍；在测试时引导设置中优于 LPB；通过匹配数据量的消融实验证明，性能提升来自引导恢复数据而非单纯增加 rollout 数量。

Conclusion: ReGuide 通过将测试时的引导 rollout 转化为可复用的训练数据，实现了策略的自我改进，有效缓解了行为克隆中的协变量偏移问题，且不依赖外部专家或复杂假设。

Abstract: Behavior-cloned diffusion policies are expressive but remain vulnerable to covariate shift: small deviations from demonstrated states can compound into task failure. Existing methods address this either by expanding the training distribution through expert corrections or synthetic augmentation, or by steering a frozen policy at test time with guidance from a learned model. The former can be expensive or assumption-dependent, while the latter discards the corrected trajectories after execution. We introduce ReGuide, a self-improving framework that treats guided rollouts as reusable on-policy recovery data. ReGuide first uses Phase-Conditioned Guidance (PCG) to generate corrective rollouts: it constructs phase-specific latent targets, applies guidance only in the drifted-but-recoverable regime, and guides through the estimated clean action to match the dynamics model's training distribution. Successful guided rollouts are then absorbed back into the policy through ReGuide-FT, which fine-tunes the current checkpoint, or ReGuide-FS, which retrains from scratch on the augmented dataset; the two can also be composed and iterated. On Robomimic Can, Square, Transport, and Tool Hang, ReGuide improves base-policy success by $1.3$--$7.7\times$, outperforms LPB in the test-time-only setting, and matched-data ablations show that the gains come from guided recovery data rather than additional rollouts alone.

</details>


### [275] [Curvature-Weighted Gradient Diversity: A Noise Measure for Geometry-Adaptive SGD Schedules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30455)
*Muhammad Hamza,Ayush Goel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出曲率加权梯度多样性（CWGD），一种几何感知的噪声度量，利用逆Hessian平方根对每样本梯度多样性加权，从而更紧地刻画有效优化噪声。在强凸二次目标下，CWGD调制的余弦学习率调度可将渐近优化误差下限降低至标准余弦退火的一半，并在各类条件数、批量大小和噪声结构下实现约20%更低的最终优化误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准小批量SGD的收敛分析使用单一方差项建模梯度噪声，平等对待所有参数方向，忽略了高曲率方向的噪声影响较小（因为学习率已受约束）这一事实。为此，需要一种几何感知的噪声度量来更准确地刻画优化噪声。

Method: 提出CWGD度量，将每样本梯度多样性用Hessian逆平方根加权；基于Hutchinson对角Hessian估计器实现CWGD-Cosine算法；在强凸二次目标下给出理论收敛分析；识别并修正了退化曲率估计器，分析估计器鲁棒性。

Result: CWGD-Cosine相比标准余弦退火：在强凸二次目标下渐近优化误差下限最多降低一半；在不同条件数、批量大小和噪声结构下，最终优化误差一致降低约20%；计算开销可忽略。

Conclusion: CWGD是一种原则性的几何感知优化噪声度量，在二次优化中效果显著，但非凸优化中存在Hessian陈旧性等局限，未来可推广至更一般的学习问题。

Abstract: The standard convergence analysis of mini-batch stochastic gradient descent (SGD) models gradient noise using a single variance term that treats all parameter directions equally, ignoring the fact that noise in high-curvature directions has less impact because learning rates are already constrained there. We introduce Curvature-Weighted Gradient Diversity (CWGD), a geometry-aware measure that weights per-sample gradient diversity by the inverse square root of the Hessian, providing a tighter proxy for the effective optimization noise. For strongly convex quadratic objectives with diagonal Hessians and isotropic noise, we prove that a CWGD-modulated cosine learning-rate schedule can reduce the asymptotic optimization error floor by up to a factor of two compared with standard cosine annealing. We implement this idea as CWGD-Cosine using a Hutchinson-based diagonal Hessian estimator that is exact for quadratic objectives. Across a range of condition numbers, batch sizes, and noise structures, CWGD-Cosine consistently achieves approximately 20% lower final optimization error than standard cosine annealing while incurring negligible overhead in the quadratic setting. We also identify and correct a degenerate curvature estimator, analyze the robustness of the proposed estimator, and explicitly discuss the limitations of the method, including Hessian staleness in non-convex optimization. These results establish CWGD as a principled geometry-aware measure of optimization noise and motivate future extensions to more general learning problems.

</details>


### [276] [Machine-learnable Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28947)
*Veit Elser,Manish Krishan Lal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了具有易识别、易生成、易学习三大特性的大型离散集合，并将其特化为二进制字符串集合，提出基于有界复杂度布尔自编码器的"机器可学习性"定义。通过布尔阈值函数网络实现自编码器，在Rorschach模式和更"狂野"的集合上进行了实验验证，并展示了一种通过迭代将野集转化为可机器学习的简单方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为大型离散集合的"可学习性"提供形式化定义，填补该领域缺乏严格数学框架的空白，并探索通过布尔自编码器实现机器学习的可行性。

Method: 1. 形式化定义具备三种性质（易识别、易生成、易学习）的大型离散集合；2. 将定义特化为二进制字符串集合；3. 提出基于有界复杂度布尔自编码器的机器可学习性定义；4. 使用布尔阈值函数网络实现自编码器进行实验；5. 对Rorschach模式和"野集"进行学习实验；6. 设计迭代方法将野集转化为可机器学习集合。

Result: 在Rorschach模式上成功验证了机器可学习性（包括镜像半区对比反转的情况）；对于更"狂野"的集合，虽然元素只能被可接受自编码器近似固定，但通过简单迭代可以将野集演化为可机器学习的集合。

Conclusion: 提出了一种形式化的离散集合可学习性框架及基于布尔自编码器的实现方法，证明了即使对于初始不可学习的野集，也可以通过迭代演化的方式使其变得可机器学习。

Abstract: In this study we present a formal definition of large discrete sets having, informally, three properties: their elements are easily recognized, easily generated, and the latter tasks are easily learned from examples. The formalism is specialized to sets of binary strings and a definition of "machine-learnability" based on the existence of a bounded-complexity Boolean autoencoder that fixes the elements of the set. We present experiments where the autoencoders are implemented by nets of Boolean threshold functions. Machine-learnability is demonstrated for Rorschach patterns (that may have reversed contrast in the mirrored half), and considerably "wilder" sets whose elements are only approximately fixed by admissible autoencoders. In the second case we demonstrate a simple iteration that evolves wild sets to make them properly machine-learnable.

</details>


### [277] [Convergence of Continual Learning in Homogeneous Deep Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30559)
*Matan Schliserman,Gon Buzaglo,Itay Evron,Daniel Soudry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文刻画了同构模型中弱正则化持续分类问题为任务间隔集上的顺序投影，将先前仅适用于静态深度模型或持续线性模型的分析推广到更一般的情况。研究表明即使模型在数据上线性但在参数上非线性，全局收敛通常失败。然而，通过利用非凸投影理论的结果，论文识别了同构深度网络的正则性属性，保证了随机和循环任务序列下的局部线性收敛。最后，将分析扩展到持续回归，统一了同构模型的框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习理论分析要么局限于静态（单任务）深度模型，要么局限于持续线性模型，缺乏对更一般的同构模型在持续学习场景下的理论理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立一个更统一的持续学习理论框架。

Method: 将弱正则化持续分类问题形式化为同构模型在任务间隔集上的顺序投影；利用非凸投影理论分析模型的收敛性；识别同构深度网络的局部正则性属性；将分析从分类任务扩展到回归任务。

Result: 证明了全局收敛在即使简单的参数非线性模型中通常失败；识别了同构深度网络的正则性属性，保证了随机和循环任务序列下的局部线性收敛；将分析统一扩展到持续回归任务。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了同构模型持续学习的一般理论框架，揭示了局部收敛性保证的条件，并为未来持续学习算法的理论分析提供了基础。

Abstract: We characterize weakly regularized continual classification in homogeneous models as sequential projections onto task margin sets. This result generalizes prior analyses restricted to either stationary (single-task) deep models or continual linear models. We show that global convergence generally fails, even for simple models linear in data but nonlinear in parameters. Nevertheless, by leveraging results from nonconvex projection theory, we identify regularity properties of homogeneous deep networks that guarantee local linear convergence under random and cyclic task sequences. Finally, we extend our analysis to continual regression, unifying the framework for homogeneous models.

</details>


### [278] [Modification-Considering Value Learning for Reward Hacking Mitigation in RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28955)
*Evgenii Opryshko,Umangi Jain,Igor Gilitschenski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MCVL是一种基于当前效用优化的离策略价值学习框架，通过过滤可能降低冻结自举回报估计的转移样本来防御奖励破解，在网格世界和MuJoCo任务中验证了其安全性与兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有奖励破解防御方法通过约束策略靠近已知安全参考，在抑制破解与允许合法改进之间存在矛盾，需要一种既能防止奖励破解又不阻碍正常性能提升的方法。

Method: MCVL包装离策略学习器，对每个新转移样本视为候选修改：预测包含与不包含该样本的两条训练路径，使用冻结的自举回报估计器（由奖励模型和价值函数导出）打分，仅当包含样本不会降低得分时才接受该转移。

Result: 在四个安全相关网格世界和三个改进MuJoCo连续控制任务中，MCVL有效缓解了奖励破解，同时继续提升预期目标的表现。

Conclusion: MCVL在理论上形式化了安全性与兼容性的条件，实践上基于DDQN和TD3实现了防御奖励破解的离策略学习，平衡了安全约束与性能提升。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents can exploit misspecified reward signals to achieve high apparent returns while failing on the intended objective, a failure mode known as reward hacking. Existing practical defenses typically constrain policy updates to stay near a known safe reference, creating a tension between suppressing hacking and permitting legitimate improvement. We propose Modification-Considering Value Learning (MCVL), which operationalizes the theoretical idea of current utility optimization for standard value-based RL. MCVL wraps an off-policy learner and treats each incoming transition as a candidate modification: it forecasts two training paths, one that includes the transition and one that does not, and scores both with a frozen bootstrapped-return estimator derived from a learned reward model and value function. The transition is admitted only if inclusion does not decrease the score. We formalize conditions under which this filtering is both safe and permissive, and instantiate MCVL with DDQN and TD3. Across four safety-relevant gridworlds and three modified MuJoCo continuous-control tasks with diverse hacking mechanisms, MCVL mitigates reward hacking while continuing to improve the intended objective. Project website: ktolnos.github.io/mcvl/.

</details>


### [279] [RGLD: Randomized Global-Local Density Estimation for Tabular Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28970)
*Quanling Zhao,Jiaying Yang,Ye Tian,Josh Victoria,Zhijun Wang,Pietro Mercati,Onat Gungor,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RGLD是一种随机全局-局部密度估计器，通过全局随机特征密度分支和局部邻居分支相结合，在特征袋装随机视图上检测异常，在47个表格数据集上对比23个基线方法取得了最优的AUROC性能和第二的AUPRC性能，同时比所有深度检测器快50-580倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督表格异常检测方法存在短板：经典统计检测器效率高但依赖固定数据视图和单一异常概念，深度检测器灵活但速度慢且缺乏可靠监督信号难以调参。需要一种兼具准确率、鲁棒性和计算效率的方法。

Method: RGLD结合两个分支：1) 全局随机特征密度分支，识别整体低密度区域的样本；2) 局部邻居分支，检测缺乏邻近观测支持的样本。两个分支均在特征袋装随机视图上操作，能暴露单一表示中隐藏的异常证据。

Result: 在47个表格数据集上对比23个统计和深度检测基线，RGLD在数据集级AUROC上排名第一（胜场数最多），在AUPRC胜场数上排名第二。同时比所有深度检测器快50-580倍，与统计方法运行时间相当。

Conclusion: RGLD在无监督表格异常检测中实现了准确率与计算效率的优越平衡，表明随机视图上的全局-局部密度估计策略是一种高效且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection requires methods that are accurate, robust across heterogeneous datasets, and computationally efficient. Classical statistical detectors are often efficient, but they usually rely on a fixed data view and a single notion of abnormality. Deep anomaly detectors can learn more flexible scoring functions, but they are substantially slower and difficult to tune in unsupervised settings due to the lack of a reliable supervisory signal. We propose RGLD, a randomized global-local density estimator for efficient unsupervised tabular anomaly detection. RGLD combines a global random-feature density branch, which identifies samples in broadly low-density regions, with a local neighbor branch, which detects samples that are weakly supported by nearby observations. Both branches operate over feature-bagged randomized views, allowing RGLD to expose anomaly evidence that may be hidden in any single representation. We conduct experiments on 47 tabular datasets against 23 statistical and deep anomaly detection baselines under fully unsupervised setting. RGLD achieves the strongest dataset-level AUROC performance, ranking 1st in dataset wins, and ranks 2nd in AUPRC wins. RGLD is also faster than all evaluated deep detectors, achieving 50x-580x speedups, and remains competitive with statistical methods in runtime, yielding a favorable accuracy-efficiency tradeoff.

</details>


### [280] [On Surrogate Modeling of Static Response of AM Short-Fiber Thermoplastics Using Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28996)
*Pharindra Pathak,Vipin Kumar,Trenton M. Ricks,Suhasini Gururaja,Siddhartha Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的代理框架，结合图神经网络与长短期记忆网络（GNN-LSTM），用于预测短纤维热塑性复合材料（SFTs）的力学行为。该框架通过Voronoi单元离散化微观结构、非线性有限元均质化及混合深度学习架构，实现了对刚度与应力-应变曲线的高精度预测（R²≈0.98），并将计算成本降低两个数量级以上，为SFT构件数字孪生开发提供了物理信息驱动的有效途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短纤维热塑性复合材料（SFTs）因优越的比强度、高生产速率和可回收性而广泛用于轻量化结构，但其力学响应受纤维取向、空间聚集和制造孔隙等介观尺度特征控制，且存在显著空间变异性。尽管介观有限元模型能解析此类异质性，但在真实三维微观结构上的计算成本过高，亟需高效且准确的替代方法。

Method: 首先从显微CT数据重建微观结构，采用Voronoi单元离散化以表征纤维相互作用邻域；随后对每个单元进行考虑基体损伤的非线性有限元均质化，获取应力-应变响应；最后构建混合GNN-LSTM架构，其中GNN编码微观结构拓扑信息，LSTM捕捉历史相关的力学演化过程，实现代理模型训练。

Result: 代理模型对未见微观结构的刚度和应力-应变行为预测精度达R²≈0.98，相较有限元模拟计算成本降低两个数量级以上。结合实验标定的损伤法则，揭示纤维取向、聚集和孔隙率共同控制局部有效刚度。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一条物理信息驱动、数据高效的路径，能够识别力学薄弱微观结构单元，加速SFT构件的数字孪生开发，兼具精度与计算效率优势。

Abstract: Short-fiber thermoplastic (SFT) composites are increasingly employed in lightweight aerospace and automotive structures owing to their favorable strength-to-weight ratio, high production rates, and recyclability. Unlike continuous-fiber systems, the mechanical response of SFTs is governed by mesoscale interactions among fiber orientation, spatial clustering, and manufacturing-induced porosity. These features exhibit significant spatial variability in manufactured components and influence stiffness, damage initiation, and nonlinear deformation. Although mesoscale finite element (FE) models can resolve such heterogeneity, their application to realistic three-dimensional microstructures remains computationally intractable.
  A data-driven surrogate framework is proposed to predict the mechanical behavior of additively manufactured, compression-molded (AM-CM) SFTs. Microstructures reconstructed from micro-computed tomography data were discretized into Voronoi-based cells representing distinct fiber-interaction neighborhoods. Each cell was homogenized via nonlinear FE simulations incorporating matrix damage, and the resulting stress-strain responses trained a hybrid Graph Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory (GNN-LSTM) architecture encoding microstructural topology and history-dependent mechanical evolution.
  The surrogate accurately predicts stiffness and stress-strain behavior of unseen microstructures, achieving $R^2\approx 0.98$ relative to high-fidelity FE simulations with over two orders-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost. Coupling the framework with experimentally calibrated damage laws demonstrates that fiber orientation, clustering, and porosity collectively govern local effective stiffness. The approach provides a physics-informed, data-efficient pathway to identify mechanically weak microstructural cells and accelerate digital-twin development for SFT components.

</details>


### [281] [How Far Can Sharpness and Complexity Jointly Explain Generalization?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29043)
*Ziyu Cheng,Xitong Zhang,Longxiu Huang,Rongrong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了锐度（sharpness）和复杂度（complexity）两种因素如何共同解释深度神经网络的泛化能力，提出了帕累托分析方法和面向函数空间的定义，发现联合解释力优于单一指标，但仍不能完全解释泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有泛化性度量大多关注单一标量指标，忽视了锐度与复杂度的联合解释力，本文旨在探索二者如何共同解释深度神经网络的泛化行为。

Method: 使用线性回归和基于帕累托分析的方法，提出面向函数空间（而非参数层面）的锐度与复杂度定义，定量评估二者的联合解释力。

Result: 函数导向的锐度和复杂度定义比现有参数层面指标扩大了双因素视角的解释范围，但仍存在无法解释的泛化失败案例。

Conclusion: 锐度-复杂度视角是理解泛化的重要视角，但能否作为泛化的完整理论仍有待验证。

Abstract: Sharpness and complexity are two central factors in the generalization analysis of deep neural networks. Existing quantitative evaluations of generalization measures have largely focused on individual scalar measures, leaving the joint explanatory power of sharpness and complexity largely unexplored. This work studies how far sharpness and complexity can jointly explain generalization. We use linear regression and introduce a Pareto-based analysis to quantitatively evaluate the joint explanatory power of these two factors. Beyond the existing parameter-level definitions, we further propose realizations of sharpness and complexity that are closer to function space and less dependent on raw parameter representations. We find that function-oriented definitions of these two quantities expand the explanatory scope of the two-factor view beyond what is achieved by existing parameter-level metrics. Overall, our results support the sharpness-complexity perspective as an informative lens for understanding generalization across diverse settings. At the same time, the remaining failures indicate that whether this two-factor view can serve as a complete theory of generalization remains open.

</details>


### [282] [MOSAIC: Orchestrating Collaborative Knowledge Tracing with Hierarchical Semantic Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29049)
*Xinjin Li,Mengyue Wang,Yuzhen Lin,Pengbin Feng,Ziqi Sha,Yeyang Zhou,Yu Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MOSAIC是一个融合大语言模型语义对齐与序列建模的多粒度知识追踪框架，通过冻结LLM生成动态嵌入和分层预测提示，并引入跨粒度一致性目标，在多个基准数据集上取得SOTA结果（AUC提升最高3.4%，准确率提升最高2.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统知识追踪方法存在两个关键局限：一是依赖浅层ID表示，忽视了语义深度；二是局限于单一粒度 mastery 估计，无法捕捉层次化的知识依赖关系。

Method: MOSAIC框架包含三个核心创新：(1) 利用冻结的LLM生成动态、上下文感知的嵌入和分层预测提示；(2) 显式捕捉协作信号和同伴交互；(3) 引入跨粒度一致性目标，联合正则化概念级、主题聚类级和全局熟练度三个层级的 mastery 估计。

Result: 在ASSISTments、EdNet和大型MOOC数据集上，MOSAIC在所有基准上取得SOTA结果，AUC提升最高3.4%，准确率提升最高2.5%。在协作密集环境和长序列场景下表现尤为鲁棒（MOOC数据集AUC达0.862）。

Conclusion: MOSAIC不仅提供了高预测精度，还具备语义可解释性，证明了LLM驱动的语义对齐与多粒度一致性约束相结合的有效性。

Abstract: Knowledge Tracing (KT) is important for personalized education but traditionally suffers from two key limitations: a reliance on shallow ID-based representations that neglect semantic depth and a restriction to single-granularity mastery estimation that overlooks hierarchical knowledge dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose MOSAIC (Multi-granularity Online Semantic AI for Collaborative Knowledge), a novel framework that orchestrates LLM-driven semantic alignment with sequential modeling. Unlike methods that use LLMs solely as predictors, MOSAIC leverages a frozen LLM to generate dynamic, context-aware embeddings and hierarchical prediction prompts, explicitly capturing collaborative signals and peer interactions. Furthermore, we introduce a cross-granularity consistency objective that jointly regularizes mastery estimation across concept, topic-cluster, and global proficiency levels. Extensive experiments on ASSISTments, EdNet, and a newly collected large-scale MOOC dataset demonstrate that MOSAIC establishes new state-of-the-art results. Specifically, our method achieves AUC improvements of up to 3.4\% and Accuracy gains of up to 2.5 \% across all benchmarks. Notably, MOSAIC exhibits superior robustness in collaboration-rich environments and long-sequence scenarios (AUC 0.862 on MOOC), offering both high predictive precision and semantically grounded interpretability.

</details>


### [283] [A Kernel Fisher Discriminant Analysis-Based Tree Ensemble Classifier: KFDA Forest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29053)
*Donghwan Kim,Seung Hwan Park,Jun-Geol Baek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种名为核Fisher判别分析森林（KFDA Forest）的集成分类器，它基于树集成方法并应用KFDA技术。通过bootstrap和随机划分变量集为K个子集来提升多样性，在每个子集上执行KFDA以提高分类精度。KFDA能最大化类间距离同时最小化类内距离，并利用核技巧处理非线性数据结构。使用决策树作为基分类器，在UCI和KEEL数据集上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成分类器通常比单一分类器更准确，因此希望设计一种新的集成方法进一步提升分类性能。

Method: 提出KFDA Forest集成分类器：使用bootstrap进行样本重采样，将变量集随机划分为K个子集；在每个子集上执行KFDA（核Fisher判别分析），利用核技巧将输入空间映射到核特征空间实现旋转；以决策树作为基分类器进行集成。

Result: 在UCI和KEEL真实数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的KFDA Forest方法优于现有集成方法。

Conclusion: KFDA Forest作为一种基于树集成的核Fisher判别分析方法，通过bootstrap和随机子空间划分增强多样性，结合KFDA的类间/类内距离优化与核技巧的非线性处理能力，有效提升了集成分类器的性能。

Abstract: In general, an ensemble classifier is more accurate than a single classifier. In this study, we propose an ensemble classifier called the kernel Fisher discriminant analysis forest (KFDA Forest), which is a tree-based ensemble method that applies KFDA. To promote diversity, bootstrap is used, and variable sets are randomly divided into K subsets. KFDA is performed on each subset to increase classification accuracy. KFDA maximizes the distance between classes while minimizing the distance within classes. KFDA can also be applied to classification problems in a nonlinear data structure using the kernel trick because it can transform the input space into a kernel feature space, commonly named a rotation, rather than performing a dimensionality reduction. Because new feature axes and KFDA projections are parallel, decision trees are used as a base classifier. To compare the proposed method with existing ensemble methods, we apply these to real datasets from the UCI and KEEL repositories.

</details>


### [284] [When Can Conformal Risk Control Certify LLM Outputs? Bounds, Impossibility, and Adaptation for Structured Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29054)
*Varun Kotte*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了形式化可靠保证下的大语言模型结构化生成问题。主要贡献包括：(1) 证明了当基础风险 μ > α 时，任何无分布方法都必须在至少 ((μ-α)/(1-α)) 个样本上弃权，并提出闭式可行性检验；(2) 分析了Hoeffding、经验Bernstein和基于赌注的e-CRC三层认证层级，其中Hoeffding→Bernstein带来最大增益（+37%），e-CRC在少量标定数据下优势明显；(3) 验证了自适应共形推理（ACI）在跨数据集漂移下将风险目标违规从71%降至21%。在6个开源模型、8个数据集、4个任务上验证，硬NER/QA/CLS配置在α=0.10时不可认证，放宽到α=0.30-0.40可实现实际认证（NER 47%, QA 40%, CLS 60%）。最终给出三步部署方案：检查可行性、选择边界与分数、缓解漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型（LLM）在结构化生成任务（NER、JSON提取、QA、分类）中缺乏形式化的可靠性保证。现有的启发式弃权策略无法满足用户指定的风险目标，偏差达7.5-12.5%。作者旨在为LLM的结构化输出提供严格的可靠性认证框架。

Method: (1) 推导了共形风险控制（CRC）的不可可能性定理及闭式可行性检验公式；(2) 比较了Hoeffding、经验Bernstein和e-CRC三种认证边界的理论增益；(3) 引入自适应共形推理（ACI）应对跨数据集分布漂移；(4) 跨6个模型、8个数据集、4个任务、6个非一致性分数进行大规模实证验证。

Result: (1) 可行性检验可在运行CRC之前判断其是否奏效；(2) Hoeffding→Bernstein步骤带来37%认证配置的最大增益，e-CRC在数据稀缺时优势显著（20%数据下10%认证 vs Hoeffding的0%）；(3) ACI将风险目标违规从71%降至21%，剩余失败集中在不可能性边界预测的区域；(4) 硬配置在α=0.10时不可认证，放宽到α=0.30-0.40时可达47% NER、40% QA、60% CLS认证。

Conclusion: 本文为LLM结构化输出提供了首个全面的形式化可靠性认证框架，包含理论边界、可行性检验和实际部署指南。核心结论：LLM的结构化输出认证是可行的但存在理论极限，需要通过可行性检验先验判断、选择最优边界策略、并主动缓解分布漂移。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed for structured generation (NER, JSON extraction, QA, and classification) lack formal reliability guarantees, and standard heuristic abstention policies miss user-specified risk targets by 7.5--12.5%. We characterize when conformal risk control (CRC) can certify structured LLM outputs and when it provably cannot. First, we prove an impossibility result: when the base risk (μ> α), any distribution-free method must abstain on at least ((μ-α)/(1-α)) examples, yielding a closed-form feasibility test: one can check whether CRC will work before running it. Second, we analyze a certification hierarchy across Hoeffding, empirical Bernstein, and a betting-based e-CRC bound, with strict gains in low-variance/large-sample regimes: the Hoeffding-to-Bernstein step delivers the largest gain (+37% certified configurations), while e-CRC adds value when calibration data is scarce (10% certification at 20% data versus 0% for Hoeffding). Third, we validate adaptive conformal inference (ACI) under cross-dataset shift, reducing risk-target violations from 71% to 21%, with residual failures concentrated exactly where the impossibility bound predicts. Across six open-weight models (3B--72B parameters), eight datasets, four tasks, and six nonconformity scores, hard NER/QA/CLS configurations are uncertifiable at (α= 0.10); relaxing to (α= 0.30--0.40) unlocks practical certification (47% NER, 40% QA, 60% CLS). The framework gives a three-step deployment recipe: check feasibility, select the bound and score, then mitigate shift.

</details>


### [285] [Statistically Indistinguishable, Operationally Distinct: A Formal Barrier for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29091)
*Tassilo Klein,Johannes Hoffart*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"操作图灵测试"(OTT)，证明仅基于数值的表格基础模型无法识别违反系统运行规则的数据状态，且该缺陷源于可识别性（identifiability）而非模型容量或数据规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型缺乏对系统运行规则的访问，无法推理数据状态是否合法，作者试图验证这一论断并量化其根本原因。

Method: 构建OTT：生成合法与违规数据库状态对，其1-2维列值边际分布差异<0.02；利用Le Cam引理给出数值分类器贝叶斯误差下界≥0.49。在多个基准（XGBoost、TabICL、TabPFN）及LLM上进行测试，并引入可执行规则审计与SQL执行器进行对比。

Result: 纯数值方法准确率恰好为0.50（TOST p<0.002），LLM最多在50个合法状态中识别2个为LEGAL，GPT-5.5全部拒绝。仅引入可执行规则审计的分类器达到1.00准确率。该模式在第二个规则族（银行账本）上复现。

Conclusion: 表格基础模型的根本瓶颈是可识别性（identifiability），而非规模、数据或特征丰富度；必须依赖操作规则的可执行审计才能跨越这一障碍。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models cannot reason about data produced by running systems without access to the rules that govern them. We make this statement falsifiable. The \emph{Operational Turing Test} (OTT) constructs pairs of legal and rule-violating database states whose $1$- and $2$-way column-value marginals match to a total variation of $<0.02$; Le~Cam's lemma then bounds any values-only classifier at $\geq0.49$ Bayes error. Three values-only baselines (XGBoost, TabICL, TabPFN) hit the bound exactly (accuracy $0.50$, pre-registered two one-sided tests (TOST) $p<0.002$), raw row-level access does not help, exposing relational value consistency closes most of the gap, and only a classifier fed by seven executable rule-derived audits reaches $1.00$ classification accuracy. In three matched $100$-state frontier large-language-model (LLM) runs, models given the schema, trigger source, rule tables, and state files classify at most $2/50$ legal states as LEGAL; GPT-5.5 accepts $0/50$ legal states even with higher reasoning effort and a Structured Query Language (SQL) executor. The access-ladder pattern also appears on a second schema with structurally distinct rule families (banking ledger: cross-row balance, cumulative aggregate). The barrier is identifiability, not capacity: scale, data, and richer features cannot cross it without operational grounding.

</details>


### [286] [Priced Motion Through Optimal Faces: A Normal-Fan Geometry for Non-Stationary Adversarial MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29092)
*Kai Hidajat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对有限时域对抗性MDP（固定转移）提出了一种"法扇形几何"框架，将非平稳奖励路径映射到占用多面体的法扇形上，定义了"穿越面的代价"（face-crossing price）来衡量最优策略改变所固有的遗憾，实现了将动态遗憾分解为内在的面运动代价（consequential non-stationarity）和面内选择误差（harmless non-stationarity），从而区分了有影响与无害的非平稳性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准动态遗憾分析将非平稳代价等同于损失移动的大小，但损失大幅移动可能不改变最优策略，而微小移动却可能迫使最优策略完全改变。因此，现有基于损失变化、转移变化或比较器路径长度的度量描述的是对抗者的运动幅度，而非该运动对控制问题造成的实际代价。本文旨在建立一种更忠实于问题的分析几何，以区分"有后果的"与"无害的"非平稳性。

Method: 1) 构建有限时域对抗性MDP（固定转移）的占用测度多面体及其法扇形几何；2) 每个损失向量暴露多面体的一个最优面，非平稳奖励序列对应法扇形中的一条路径；3) 定义"穿越面的代价"（face-crossing price），即在新损失下仍然停留在前一个最优面所必然产生的最小遗憾；4) 证明动态遗憾可精确分解为内在的面穿越代价（consequential）与面内选择误差（harmless）。

Result: 损失变化可以在零代价下任意大（即完全无害的非平稳性），而相同的一坐标变化可能隐藏着horizon尺度的遗憾差异。动态遗憾被精确分解为两部分：面穿越代价（由最优策略变化固有导致）和面内选择误差（同一最优面内的选择问题）。

Conclusion: 本文提供的法扇形几何框架比传统的损失变化/转移变化度量更精确地刻画了非平稳性对控制问题的实际代价，分离了有后果与无害的非平稳性，为动态遗憾分析提供了更忠实于问题的解释工具。

Abstract: In a changing decision problem, standard dynamic-regret analyses have often equated the cost of non-stationarity to how far loss moves. However, it is simultaneously possible for a loss sequence to travel far and retain the same optimal policy, or for a small movement in loss to force the optimal policy to change completely. Thus, the size of the movement through loss variation, transition variation, or comparator path length describe the adversary's motion, but not the cost of that motion to the control problem. For a more faithful analytic interpretation, this paper develops a normal-fan geometry for finite-horizon adversarial MDPs with fixed transitions. Occupancy measures form a polytope, and each loss vector exposes an optimal face of that polytope. Non-stationarity in rewards is therefore a path through the normal fan, where motion inside one cone leaves the optimal face unchanged, while crossing a wall may carry regret. We pose the notion of a face-crossing price, which is the minimum regret incurred by remaining on the previous optimal face under the new loss. For any learner that tracks the previous face, dynamic regret decomposes exactly into intrinsic priced face motion plus within-face selection error. The resulting theory separates consequential from harmless non-stationarity, where loss variation can be arbitrarily large at zero price, and identical one-coordinate variation can hide horizon-scale differences in regret.

</details>


### [287] [DiLaServe: High SLO Attainment Serving for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29094)
*Tzu-Tao Chang,Benjamin Yuanyang Hong,Kiet Pham,Shivaram Venkataraman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DiLaServe是一个面向扩散语言模型(DLM)的集群级服务系统，通过置信度阈值调整的截止时间感知调度、自适应负载控制以及质量感知的动态集群重配置，解决了DLM在吞吐量、延迟SLO和生成质量之间的权衡问题，在多个基准测试中SLO达标率提升高达56.6个百分点，端到端延迟降低46%，准确率下降不到1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(DLM)虽能并行生成多个token以提高推理吞吐量，但其独特特性（如基于置信度的去噪带来的速度-质量权衡、负载波动下的并行化水平选择、近似KV缓存导致的非均匀步级成本）给满足延迟SLO的服务系统带来了新挑战，现有系统无法有效应对。

Method: 提出DiLaServe系统，包含三个关键组件：(1) 截止时间感知调度与自适应负载控制，通过动态调整置信度阈值来管理速度-质量权衡；(2) 质量感知优化问题求解，动态重配置集群资源；(3) 显式建模近似KV缓存引入的步级异质性，以优化调度决策。

Result: 在多个基准测试和真实世界负载轨迹下，DiLaServe将SLO达标率提升高达56.6个百分点，端到端请求延迟降低46%，同时准确率下降不超过1%。

Conclusion: DiLaServe有效解决了DLM服务系统中的关键挑战，在不显著牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅提升了服务性能和SLO达标率，为扩散语言模型的工业化部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional autoregressive language models. By generating multiple tokens in parallel during each denoising step, they offer higher inference throughput while maintaining competitive quality. However, realizing these throughput gains while meeting latency SLOs in a serving system requires addressing challenges introduced by DLMs' unique characteristics. These include navigating the speed-quality tradeoff created by confidence-based denoising, choosing appropriate parallelization levels across model instances under fluctuating load, and coordinating approximate KV caching mechanisms that introduce non-uniform per-step costs. To address these challenges, we present DiLaServe, a cluster-level serving system for DLMs. DiLaServe enables deadline-aware scheduling and adaptive load control through confidence-threshold adjustment, and dynamically reconfigures the cluster by solving a quality-aware optimization problem, while explicitly modeling the step-level heterogeneity introduced by approximate KV caching. Across multiple benchmarks and real-world traces, DiLaServe improves SLO attainment by up to 56.6 percentage points and reduces end-to-end request latency by up to 46\% while incurring less than 1\% accuracy drop.

</details>


### [288] [Few-Step Boltzmann Generators via Scalable Likelihood Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29110)
*RuiKang OuYang,Hanlin Yu,Xinyue Ai,Yutong He,Nicholas M. Boffi,Pradeep Ravikumar,Jose Miguel Hernandez-Lobato,Max Simchowitz,Benjamin Kurt Miller,Omar Chehab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SCALLOP是一种基于流模型的似然蒸馏方法，通过无Hutchinson估计器的向量化目标函数，在分子科学和图像数据集上实现了比F2D2更低的训练方差、更快的训练速度，并达到最快基线10倍的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流模型在少量函数评估下能生成高质量样本，但似然估计方面进展不足——要么依赖限制性架构进行精确计算，要么使用Hutchinson迹估计器等随机近似引入较大方差。

Method: 基于F2D2似然流图模型，提出一种无Hutchinson估计器的可扩展似然蒸馏目标函数，支持向量化实现，替代原F2D2中的Hutchinson估计器进行训练。

Result: 在分子科学（Boltzmann生成器）和图像数据集上，SCALLOP相比F2D2显著降低了训练方差和训练时间，性能持续提升；与最先进方法竞争，同时实现最快基线10倍的推理加速。

Conclusion: SCALLOP通过无Hutchinson的向量化似然蒸馏目标，有效解决了流模型似然估计中的方差和效率问题，在多个领域展现出优异性能与推断速度优势。

Abstract: Recent progress in flow-based generative modeling has led to models that output high-quality samples while using only a small number of function evaluations. However, at present, there is a lack of similar advances in estimating the model likelihood. In particular, most existing methods either rely on restrictive architectures that enable exact calculations, or use stochastic approximations such as Hutchinson's trace estimator that introduce substantial variance. In this work, we introduce SCAlable LikeLihood distillation of flOw maPs (SCALLOP). SCALLOP builds on the recently proposed F2D2, a likelihood flow map model that can generate samples and their densities in a small number of function evaluations. While F2D2 uses Hutchinson's estimator during training, we introduce an alternative and more scalable likelihood distillation objective that is Hutchinson-free and admits a vectorized formulation. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SCALLOP as a Boltzmann generator in molecular science, and further validate its benefit on image datasets. SCALLOP significantly reduces both training variance and training time while consistently improving performance compared to F2D2, and is competitive with the state-of-the-art while achieving up to 10x inference speedup over the fastest baseline.

</details>


### [289] [A Novel Latent-Class Attack and its Detection by Class Subspace Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29112)
*Guangmingmei Yang,David J. Miller,George Kesidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为“潜在类别攻击”的新型数据投毒攻击方式，将来自未知类别的样本错误标记为已知目标类别，使模型将未知类别学习为目标类别的子类；同时提出基于“类别子空间正交化”（CSO）的训练后防御方法，无需访问训练集即可检测此类攻击，并在图像分类领域提供可视化解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习方法通常依赖大量训练数据，容易受到数据投毒攻击（包括通用错误攻击和后门/木马攻击），现有攻击和防御方法针对已知类别，缺乏对利用未知类别进行攻击的研究与防护。

Method: (1) 攻击方法：将属于未知类别的所有投毒样本错误标记为某个已知目标类别，使模型学习将未知类别识别为目标类别的子类；(2) 防御方法：提出“类别子空间正交化”（CSO）范式，在不访问训练集的情况下，寻找内部表示与任何已知类别不对齐、但模型却高置信度将其归为某一已知类别的输入；(3) 可视化方法：针对图像分类领域，对估计的未知类别实例进行可视化，提供可解释性。

Result: 提出的潜在类别攻击能够成功欺骗基于AI的访问控制系统（如将“敌人”分类为“朋友”）；基于CSO的防御方法能够有效检测此类攻击；可视化方法为检测结果提供了可解释性。

Conclusion: 潜在类别攻击是一种利用未知类别进行数据投毒的新范式，具有现实威胁性，而所提出的CSO防御框架在不依赖训练集的情况下能有效检测该类攻击，并提升了现有后门检测器的性能。

Abstract: Deep learning, which in general relies on voluminous amounts of training data, is vulnerable to data poisoning attacks, including error-generic attacks and backdoors (Trojans). In this work, we propose a new data poisoning attack we dub a latent class attack. Here, all poisoned examples are from a class that is novel (unknown) for the given classification domain and are mislabeled to one of the known classes (the target class) of the domain, so that the model learns to recognize the novel class as a sub-class of the target class. Such attacks could be used e.g. to defeat AI-based access control systems, or could cause a "foe" to be classified as a "friend". We also propose a post-training defense to detect this attack, without any access to the training set. This detection approach builds on "class subspace orthogonalization" (CSO), a plug-and-play paradigm demonstrated to improve existing backdoor detectors. Here, CSO is used to seek an input (a putative unknown class instance) whose internal representation is not aligned with any of the known classes, and yet which is classified with confidence to one of these classes. Finally, specific to image classification domains, we propose a method for visualizing the estimated unknown class instance, providing explainability to our latent class detections.

</details>


### [290] [How Token Influence Decays with Distance: A Green-Function View of Trained Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29139)
*Matthias Brändel,Stephan Köhler,Oliver Rheinbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了自回归Transformer语言模型中，输入token嵌入的微小扰动如何影响后续token的预测。受微分方程迭代求解器和算子学习的启发，作者发现训练后的模型中，token间的影响随距离呈幂律衰减（指数约0.7-0.9），而非指数衰减。这种长程敏感性是训练习得的性质，在随机初始化模型中不存在，且即使打乱token导致语法崩溃后仍持续存在。这一发现表明层次化或粗粒度机制可用于利用语言模型中的长尾敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受微分方程多水平方法（如区域分解、多重网格）中强局部交互与弱但关键的全局交互分离现象的启发，探究Transformer语言模型中token间影响随距离的衰减规律，特别是是否存在类似格林函数长尾的缓慢衰减特性。

Method: 使用自动微分计算距离解析的token依赖梯度剖面（Jacobian敏感性），在Pythia和Qwen2.5-0.5B等训练好的模型上，对Gutenberg和WikiText-103语料进行实验，并通过token打乱和随机初始化对比实验验证结果。

Result: 发现对角归一化的敏感性剖面符合公式 Ḡ(r) ≈ γ + β(r+1)^(-p)，指数p约0.7-0.9（通常0.8-0.9），呈幂律衰减而非指数衰减。该模式在打乱token后仍存在，但随机初始化模型不呈现此特征。

Conclusion: 缓慢衰减的长程敏感性是训练后自回归Transformer习得的固有性质，提示语言模型中的层次化或粗粒度机制可以利用这种长尾敏感性剖面来改进建模效果。

Abstract: We study how the next-token prediction of an autoregressive Transformer language model changes under small perturbations of earlier input token embeddings. Motivated by operator learning and iterative solvers for differential equations, we investigate how the influence of one token on another decays with distance in a trained model. In multilevel methods for differential equations, such as domain decomposition, multigrid, and multilevel preconditioning, one often exploits a separation between strong local interactions and weaker but essential global interactions. The latter correspond to the long tail of the Green's function and are typically handled by a coarse-level operator. Inspired by this perspective, we compute an empirical, distance-resolved gradient profile of token dependencies using autograd.
