Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlexTab是一种灵活的编码器-解码器架构，使用任务无关的编码器与多个任务特定解码器，在表格数据的上下文学习中实现了分类、回归、异常检测、聚类、实体匹配和实体分类六种任务的最优或竞争力性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格上下文学习方法将特征表示与特定预测目标耦合，缺乏灵活性。作者希望设计一种目标无关的行嵌入，能在一个统一的框架下支持多种下游表格任务。

Method: 提出FlexTab架构，包含一个任务无关的编码器（生成目标无关的行嵌入）和多个任务特定的解码器（分别处理不同任务）。编码器和解码器均在大量真实未标注表格数据上联合训练。

Result: 在分类、回归、异常检测和实体匹配上达到SOTA；在关系数据库实体分类上与专用模型竞争力相当。证明了单一共享编码器搭配任务特定解码器可作为通用表格预测骨干网络。

Conclusion: FlexTab验证了目标无关的行嵌入设计能有效统合多种表格预测任务，为构建通用表格基础模型提供了可行路径。

Abstract: We introduce FlexTab, a flexible encoder-decoder architecture for in-context learning on tabular data that pairs a single, task-agnostic encoder with a suite of task-specific decoders. Unlike existing tabular in-context learners, which entangle feature representations with a specific prediction target, our design produces \textit{target-agnostic} row embeddings that can be leveraged across a wide range of downstream tasks within a table-native in-context learning setup. We demonstrate this flexibility on six distinct problems: classification, regression, anomaly detection, clustering, entity matching, and entity classification in relational databases. Both the encoder and the task-specific decoders are trained on a large corpus of real-world, unlabeled tables. FlexTab achieves state-of-the-art performance on classification, regression, anomaly detection and entity matching, while remaining competitive with specialized models on entity classification in a relational setting. These results demonstrate that a single shared encoder, paired with task-specific decoders, can serve as an effective general-purpose backbone for diverse tabular prediction problems. The inference code and checkpoints will be made publicly available at https://github.com/SAP-samples/flextab.

</details>


### [399] [DRIFT: Difficulty Routing Self-DIstillation with Rhythm-Gated Exploration and Success BuFfer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30345)
*Haisen Luo,Yiwei Liu,Haoning Wang,Dan Liu,Junxi Yin,Haotian Wang,Lei Zhang,Xiaoyu Tian,Shuaiting Chen,Yuansheng Song,Baoyan Guo,Xiongfei Yan,Bolan Yang,Chengwei Liu,Ming Cui,Jiong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DRIFT是一个面向大语言模型的在线自进化策略优化框架，通过难度路由（Difficulty Routing）和节奏门控（Rhythm Gating）联合机制，在问题级别和令牌级别动态调控自蒸馏与强化学习信号，结合成功缓冲区与两阶段课程学习策略，实现了稳定且高效的自改进。在五个基准和三种模型规模上，DRIFT以平均79.5%的准确率超越GRPO（+9.5%）和SDPO（+7.5%），在ToolUse任务上达到79.2%，刷新了最先进结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型自蒸馏和强化学习方法缺乏对问题级别学习进度的显式跟踪以及相应优化策略的自适应调整机制，导致训练过程中容易过度优化简单问题、从困难问题中获得弱监督信号、且未能充分探索边界情况，从而限制了模型在复杂推理任务中实现稳定的自改进。

Method: 提出DRIFT框架，核心包含两个联合机制：1）难度路由（Difficulty Routing）——在问题级别识别模型的学习状态，动态分配自蒸馏和强化学习信号；2）节奏门控（Rhythm Gating）——在令牌级别精炼策略更新，将探索集中于关键推理位置。此外引入成功缓冲区保存高质量历史经验，并采用两阶段课程学习策略，逐步引导模型从可靠行为获取向稳定策略进化过渡。

Result: 在五个基准和三种模型规模上，DRIFT在所有评估指标上均超越GRPO和SDPO的最佳性能。平均准确率79.5%，高出GRPO 9.5%、SDPO 7.5%。在ToolUse任务上准确率达79.2%，较GRPO提升13.5%、较SDPO提升10.7%，刷新了最先进水平。

Conclusion: DRIFT通过问题级别的学习进度追踪与令牌级别的探索引导，有效解决了现有方法在自改进过程中对难易问题处理失衡的问题，实现了无需外部专家监督的稳定自进化，在多个复杂推理基准上取得了显著且一致的性能提升。

Abstract: Enabling large language models to achieve stable self-improvement without external expert supervision remains a central challenge in complex reasoning tasks. Existing self-distillation and reinforcement learning methods lack explicit mechanisms for tracking problem-level learning progress and adapting optimization strategies accordingly. Consequently, training may over-optimize easy problems, receive weak supervision from hard problems, and fail to sufficiently explore borderline cases. To resolve these issues, we propose DRIFT, an online self-evolution policy optimization framework for large language models. DRIFT regulates the model's self-improvement process through the joint use of Difficulty Routing and Rhythm Gating. The former identifies the model's learning state at the problem level and dynamically allocates self-distillation and reinforcement learning signals, while the latter refines policy updates at the token level, concentrating exploration on critical reasoning positions. By further incorporating a success buffer and a two-stage curriculum learning strategy, DRIFT preserves high-quality historical experience while progressively guiding the model from reliable behavior acquisition toward stable policy evolution. Evaluated across five benchmarks and three model scales, DRIFT surpasses the peak performance of both GRPO and SDPO across all evaluated metrics. On the average score over the five benchmarks, DRIFT achieves 79.5$\%$, outperforming GRPO by 9.5$\%$ and SDPO by 7.5$\%$, establishing a new state-of-the-art result. Notably, on ToolUse, DRIFT reaches an accuracy of 79.2$\%$, improving over GRPO by 13.5$\%$ and SDPO by 10.7$\%$, setting a new state-of-the-art and substantially outperforming all concurrent methods.

</details>


### [400] [On the Vulnerability of Parameter-Level Defenses to Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30360)
*Kuangpu Guo,Qingyan Zheng,Jian Liang,Yongcan Yu,Zilei Wang,Ran He,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了现有基于线性参数变换的模型合并防御机制的漏洞，指出保护后的任务向量幅度很小导致权重仍由预训练模型主导。基于此提出Anchor-Guided Attack (AGA)通过锚定预训练模型恢复变换矩阵以绕过防御，并进一步提出Anchor-Repulsive Fine-tuning (ARF)作为对抗攻击的防御方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对模型合并中"搭便车"攻击的防御机制（基于线性参数变换）存在安全漏洞，作者旨在系统分析这些防御并揭示其根本弱点。

Method: 提出Anchor-Guided Attack (AGA)：将预训练模型作为静态参考锚点，通过与被保护模型对齐来解析恢复变换矩阵，从而绕过防御；并进一步提出Anchor-Repulsive Fine-tuning (ARF)作为缓解锚点主导效应的防御方法。

Result: AGA在防御无关的 realistic 场景下持续绕过个体和组合防御；ARF有效抵御所提出的攻击。

Conclusion: 现有的参数级线性变换防御因其保护的任务向量幅度过小存在根本性漏洞，基于锚点引导的攻击可以高效破解；通过抗锚点微调可以缓解该安全风险。

Abstract: The training-free integration of expert models via model merging has exposed significant security risks, enabling free-riders to combine specialized models without authorization. Recent works propose parameter-level defenses that employ linear parameter transformations to neutralize this threat. In this paper, we systematically analyze such defenses and reveal that their protected task vectors are inherently small in magnitude. Consequently, the protected weights remain overwhelmingly dominated by the pretrained model. Based on this observation, we designate the pretrained model as a static reference anchor and propose the Anchor-Guided Attack (AGA) to circumvent existing safeguards. Specifically, AGA aligns the protected model with this anchor to recover the transformation matrix analytically. Extensive evaluations validate that AGA consistently bypasses both individual and composite defenses under realistic defense-agnostic scenarios. Furthermore, we provide Anchor-Repulsive Fine-tuning (ARF), a defense method to mitigate the anchor dominance leveraged by AGA. Empirical results confirm that ARF effectively defeats the proposed attack. Our code is available at https://github.com/krumpguo/secure-merge-attack.

</details>


### [401] [FlowAWR: Online Adaptive Flow Reinforcement via Advantage-Weighted Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30376)
*Zheming Fu,Ruizhe He,Wei Shang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Lei Wang,Chang Liu,Siming Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FlowAWR，一种将连续生成式策略优化转化为有监督回归的方法，通过优势加权矫正推导最优速度场，实现无SDE和无CFG的生成对齐，在SD3.5-Medium上以2-5倍收敛加速达到更优的对齐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续空间上的生成流模型存在两个核心问题：(1) 基于密度近似的策略梯度方法依赖随机SDE采样器构造可计算的转移核，导致训练-推理不一致且需要无分类器引导(CFG)；(2) DiffusionNFT等隐式框架虽直接优化正向过程速度场，但其启发式的固定幅度矫正无法根据组内相对质量动态调整优化强度。

Method: FlowAWR从KL约束的奖励最大化的最优策略出发，推导出最优速度场的解析形式——一个具有幅度感知的优势加权矫正形式。该方法将连续生成式策略优化重新表述为对理论最优速度场的监督回归，从而消除了SDE采样需求和CFG依赖。

Result: 在SD3.5-Medium上的对比评估中，FlowAWR展现出更优的对齐性能，同时实现2-5倍的收敛加速（例如，1.2k步达到24.12 PickScore，而DiffusionNFT需2.0k步达到23.82，FlowGRPO需>4k步达到23.50）。在多奖励约束下，FlowAWR能保持生成质量，满足结构规则的同时维持稳定的域外性能。

Conclusion: FlowAWR通过理论推导的优势加权最优速度场，在不依赖SDE和CFG的条件下实现了高效的生成流模型对齐，显著提升了收敛速度和最终性能，且在复杂多奖励约束下仍能保持鲁棒性。

Abstract: Aligning generative flow models on continuous spaces via online reinforcement learning is constrained by intractable trajectory likelihoods. Existing density-approximated policy gradient methods rely on stochastic SDE samplers to construct tractable transition kernels, which introduce training-inference inconsistencies and necessitates Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG).
  While implicit frameworks such as DiffusionNFT directly optimize forward-process velocity fields, its heuristic fixed-magnitude corrections prevent optimization strength from relative intra-group quality.
  We propose \textit{Flow Advantage-Weighted Rectification} (\textbf{FlowAWR}), a paradigm that recasts continuous generative policy optimization as supervised regression toward a theoretically optimal velocity field.
  Starting from the optimal policy of a KL-constrained reward maximization, FlowAWR derives the optimal velocity field that admits a magnitude-aware, advantage-weighted rectification form, yielding SDE-free optimization and CFG-free generation.
  In comparative evaluations on SD3.5-Medium, FlowAWR achieves improved alignment performance alongside a 2$\times$ to 5$\times$ convergence acceleration over DiffusionNFT (e.g., reaching a 24.12 PickScore in 1.2k steps, versus 23.82 in 2.0k steps for DiffusionNFT and 23.50 in $>$4k steps for FlowGRPO). Under multi-reward constraints, FlowAWR sustains generation quality, satisfying structural rules while maintaining stable out-of-domain performance.

</details>


### [402] [Scalar Representations of Neural Network Training Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30384)
*Pedro Jiménez-González,Miguel C. Soriano,Lucas Lacasa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将神经网络训练轨迹视为时序网络，通过标量嵌入方法将其降至一维，并在MNIST分类任务的多层感知器上验证了该方法能保留原始高维空间的主要动力学特征，包括对初始条件的敏感性、最大李雅普诺夫指数重建、特征时间定义以及渐近训练状态的统计组织。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络训练过程中的参数空间维度过高，直接分析其动力学特性具有挑战性，因此需要寻找一种低维表示方法来捕捉训练轨迹的关键动力学特征。

Method: 将训练轨迹视为时序网络，应用时序网络的标量嵌入策略；在MNIST分类任务的多层感知器上进行实验，通过标量嵌入轨迹分析初始条件敏感性、最大李雅普诺夫指数、特征时间（李雅普诺夫时间）以及渐近状态的间距统计分布。

Result: 标量嵌入保留了原始高维参数空间的主要动力学特征，包括不同学习率下的初始条件敏感性、准确重建最大李雅普诺夫指数；定义了类似李雅普诺夫时间的特征时间，捕捉了高维系统中初始相近轨迹的典型去相关时间；渐近训练状态的标度间距分布在不同初始条件下坍缩为同一形式，与偏斜对数正态分布吻合。

Conclusion: 标量低维嵌入为研究和可视化神经网络优化轨迹的动力学特性提供了一种有效的框架。

Abstract: Training in artificial neural networks can be viewed as a trajectory evolving through a high-dimensional loss landscape. However, the large number of trainable parameters makes the direct analysis of these dynamics challenging. In this work, we treat such training trajectories as temporal networks and apply recently proposed strategies for the scalar embedding of temporal networks. We investigate whether such a scalar embedding provides a meaningful low-dimensional representation of neural network training dynamics. Using a multilayer perceptron trained on the MNIST classification task, we show that the embedding preserves the main dynamical features observed in the original parameter space, including the emergence of sensitivity to initial conditions for specific learning rate regimes and an accurate reconstruction of the network's maximum Lyapunov exponent. We then use the embedded scalar trajectory to define a characteristic time, analogous to a Lyapunov time, after which the exponential separation between initially close embedded trajectories saturates. This characteristic time captures the typical decorrelation time between initially close network trajectories in the original high-dimensional system. Finally, we investigate the statistical organization of asymptotic training states through a spacing observable defined in the embedded space. We find that the distributions of rescaled asymptotic spacings collapse onto a common form across initial conditions and are compatible with a skew lognormal distribution. Altogether, our results suggest that scalar low-dimensional embeddings provide a useful framework for studying and visualizing the dynamical properties of neural network optimization trajectories.

</details>


### [403] [Predict, Reuse, and Repair: Accelerating Dynamic Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30389)
*Tianyu Wang,Gourav Rattihalli,Aditya Dhakal,Junbo Li,Zhiwei Ren,Dejan Milojicic,Longfei Shangguan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRR是一个推测-重用-修复运行时系统，通过利用动态稀疏注意力（DSA）选择的时间局部性，预测并提前推测注意力计算，在真实选择结果出来后增量修复遗漏块，从而将长上下文LLM解码的每token延迟降低高达40%，同时保持下游任务精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态稀疏注意力（DSA）通过仅关注每个查询的top-K KV块来加速长上下文LLM解码，但引入了串行的选择-注意力依赖，这成为新的延迟瓶颈。

Method: PRR提出推测-重用-修复运行时：(1) 基于轻量级EMA的预测器预测可能的注意力块；(2) 在真实选择进行时推测性地对这些块进行注意力计算；(3) 一旦真实选择集确定，使用基于FlashAttention的增量修复内核，通过在线softmax统计将遗漏块合并到部分注意力状态中。同时采用剖析引导的推测预算以保持推测工作不在关键路径上。

Result: 在长上下文基准测试和代表性DSA方法上，PRR将每token解码延迟降低高达40%，同时保持下游任务精度。

Conclusion: PRR有效地消除了DSA中串行选择-注意力依赖带来的延迟瓶颈，通过时间局部性预测和增量修复实现了显著的加速。

Abstract: Dynamic sparse attention (DSA) accelerates long-context LLM decoding by attending to only the top-K KV blocks relevant to each query, but it introduces a serialized selection-to-attention dependency that emerges as a new latency bottleneck. We present PRR, a speculate-reuse-repair runtime that exploits temporal locality in DSA selections to predict likely blocks, speculate the attention over them while selection is in flight, and incrementally repair missed blocks once the true selected set is known. PRR uses a lightweight EMA-based predictor, a profiling-guided speculation budget that keeps speculative work off the critical path, and a FlashAttention-based repair kernel that folds missed blocks into the partial attention state using online-softmax statistics. Across long-context benchmarks and representative DSA methods, PRR reduces per-token decoding latency by up to 40% while preserving downstream task accuracy. Github: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/Incremental_FlashAttention

</details>


### [404] [Beyond IID: How General Are Tabular Foundation Models, Really?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30410)
*Lennart Purucker,Andrej Tschalzev,Nick Erickson,Gioia Blayer,David Holzmüller,Alan Arazi,Alexander Pfefferle,Mustafa Tajjar,Gaël Varoquaux,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BeyondArena，首个统一的表格数据基准测试平台，包含Data Foundry框架和142个数据集。评估发现现有表格基础模型在小型到中型IID数据上表现优异，但传统树模型和深度学习模型在非IID、大规模和高维数据集上仍占主导地位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型的评估基准碎片化，且仅聚焦于模型已擅长的任务（IID数据），排除了最具挑战性的场景，导致领域进步局限于IID数据的边际改进而非更广泛的挑战。

Method: 构建BeyondArena统一基准，支持多种任务类型（IID、时序、分组）、不同样本量和特征维度、多样特征类型（含文本、高基数特征），涵盖多个学科。同时开发Data Foundry框架和元数据模式，用于统一策划表格数据集。

Result: 在11个模型和142个策划数据集上的实验表明：现有表格基础模型在微型到中型IID数据上表现优异，而传统树模型和深度学习模型在非IID、大规模和高维数据集上仍占主导地位。

Conclusion: BeyondArena为表格数据中最具挑战性的问题提供了研究指导，推动真正基础性表格模型的进展。

Abstract: Foundation models for predictive machine learning on tabular data have recently gained significant traction in academia and industry. Research communities across disciplines are increasingly evaluating tabular foundation models on diverse datasets and tasks. However, these task- and discipline-specific evaluations remain largely inaccessible to model researchers because benchmark software and evaluation protocols are fragmented. As a result, model researchers rely on standard benchmarks, which are mostly defined for tasks where tabular foundation models already excel. The most challenging scenarios are excluded, limiting meaningful progress in the field by focusing on marginal improvements on IID data rather than on broader, more demanding challenges. To overcome this, we introduce BeyondArena, the first unified holistic benchmark for tabular data that supports diverse task types (IID, temporal, grouped), across sample size and feature dimensionality scales, with diverse feature types (with text, with high cardinality) from a broad range of disciplines. To enable unified benchmarking beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce Data Foundry, a Python framework and metadata schema for curating tabular datasets for predictive machine learning. Our results across 11 models and 142 curated datasets show that existing tabular foundation models excel on tiny- to medium-sized IID data, while traditional tree-based and deep learning models still dominate on non-IID, large, and high-dimensional datasets. BeyondArena guides model research for the most demanding challenges in tabular data, enabling progress towards truly foundational tabular models.

</details>


### [405] [Diffusion Fine-tuning with Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30414)
*Alexis Jacq,Guillaume Couairon,Valentin De Bortoli,Quentin Berthet,Arnaud Doucet,Romuald Elie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD)，一种同时蒸馏扩散模型并最大化奖励函数的新框架，在ImageNet上实现更优的FID-Reward权衡，并在天气预测模型GenCast上取得7.5倍加速且超越教师模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蒸馏和RL微调是扩散模型后训练的两大支柱，但两者之间的相互作用尚不明确，尤其是微调如何影响蒸馏模型的生成质量，现有研究缺乏对两者联合优化的理解。

Method: 提出RMMD框架，通过调整采样循环实现on-policy训练，并将蒸馏损失重新用作积分KL正则化的代理，从而同时进行蒸馏和奖励最大化。

Result: 在ImageNet上，RMMD在FID-Reward帕累托前沿上优于单步基线(DI++)和多步竞争者(DRaFT, HyperNoise)。在GenCast上，蒸馏模型实现7.5倍加速，在93%目标天气变量上超越教师模型，且校准更好。

Conclusion: RMMD实现了蒸馏与RL微调的有效联合优化，在图像生成和复杂科学领域（天气预测）均展现出优越性能，证明该框架可扩展到高维科学领域。

Abstract: Distillation and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning are the primary pillars of diffusion post-training. While traditionally studied in isolation, the interaction between these phases remains poorly understood, and in particular how fine-tuning impacts the generative quality of distilled models. We introduce Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD), a novel framework that simultaneously distills diffusion models and maximizes a reward function. RMMD preserves the high-fidelity ``naturalness'' characteristic of advanced distillation (such as 8-step Moment Matching) by adapting the sampling loop for on-policy training and repurposing the distillation loss as a proxy for integral KL regularization. By evaluating the FID-Reward Pareto fronts on ImageNet, we demonstrate that RMMD achieves superior trade-offs compared to single-step baselines (DI++) and multi-step competitors (DRaFT, HyperNoise). Finally, we apply RMMD to GenCast, a state-of-the-art weather forecasting model, to distill it while optimizing the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) metric. The resulting distilled model achieves a 7.5x speedup while outperforming the teacher model on 93% of target weather variables, and being better calibrated. This proves that RMMD scales to complex, high-dimensional scientific domains.

</details>


### [406] [Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30420)
*Jinda Lu,Kexin Huang,Junkang Wu,Shuo Yang,Jinghan Li,Chiyu Ma,Shaohang Wei,Xiang Wang,Guoyin Wang,Jingren Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EAPO方法，将先前RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，在关键决策点选择性注入经验，并通过改进的重要性采样实现稳定学习，在多项基准上超越现有RLVR方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法依赖从头开始的同策略优化，采样成本高，且经验复用受策略不匹配问题困扰，亟需一种策略自适应的经验复用方式。

Method: 提出Experience-Augmented Policy Optimization (EAPO)，利用先前RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，在 rollout 的关键决策点选择性注入经验，并采用自适应重要性采样方案确保稳定无偏学习。

Result: 在Qwen-2.5-math 7B和Qwen-3-8B上，基于五个不同基准的实验表明EAPO一致提升了推理性能，优于现有最先进RLVR方法。

Conclusion: 经验在RLVR中应以策略自适应方式表达而非固定轨迹复用，EAPO通过选择性经验注入和重要性采样有效解决了策略不匹配问题，为LLM推理能力提升提供了更高效的范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on on-policy optimization from scratch, resulting in high sampling costs and inefficient utilization of accumulated experience. As model capabilities and policy behaviors evolve during training, recent attempts to reuse experience via fixed reasoning trajectories further suffer from policy mismatch. Motivated by these limitations, we argue that experience in RLVR should not be reused as fixed reasoning trajectories, but instead expressed in a policy-adaptive manner. In this work, we propose Experience-Augmented Policy Optimization (EAPO), which leverages a prior RL-optimized policy as an action-level experience prior and selectively injects experience at critical decision points during rollout. To ensure stable and unbiased learning from experience-augmented rollouts, EAPO further incorporates an adapted importance sampling scheme. Experiments on using Qwen-2.5-math 7b and Qwen-3-8B on five different benchmarks demonstrate that EAPO consistently improves reasoning performance over state-of-the-art RLVR methods.

</details>


### [407] [Proofs of Ownership for Machine Learning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30423)
*Ran Canetti,Shafi Goldwasser,Or Zamir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对机器学习模型的“所有权证明”进行了形式化研究，建立了一个三方博弈框架（模型所有者、窃取者、法官），并得出一个核心二分法结论：在黑盒设置下，基于标准密码学假设，模型所有权可证明当且仅当该概念类不可自校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器学习的广泛采用，保护模型所有权成为一项迫切挑战，但目前缺乏对模型所有权证明的形式化研究。

Method: 将所有权证明建模为三方博弈（所有者、窃取者、法官），在黑盒设置下基于密码学假设进行分析，借鉴Blum-Luby-Rubinfeld的自校正概念进行理论推导。

Result: 得出一个二分法结论：模型所有权可证明当且仅当该概念类不可自校正。该结果具有构造性，并可推广到多种相关设置。

Conclusion: 建立了模型所有权证明的理论基础，明确了可证明性的条件边界，为后续研究提供了理论框架。

Abstract: With the increasing adoption of Machine Learning, protecting model ownership has become an essential challenge. We initiate a formal study of Proof of Ownership for machine learning models: under what conditions can one prove that a stolen model originated from a particular creator? We model proofs of ownership as a game among three parties: a model owner, a thief, and a judge. The owner transforms the original model into a slightly perturbed model together with a proof of ownership. The thief then obtains the transformed model and attempts to minimally modify it so that it remains useful but escapes detection as owned by the model owner. Finally, the judge receives a model and a proof of ownership, and must decide whether the given model is a modified version of some model created by the model owner, or else the given model was developed independently.
  Our main result is a dichotomy for classifiers in the black-box setting: Under standard cryptographic assumptions, ownership of models for some concept class can be proven in the above sense {\em if and only if} the concept class is not self-correctable, in a sense close to that of Blum, Luby and Rubinfeld, STOC'90. The result is constructive and extends, with some variations, to a number of related settings.

</details>


### [408] [Arko-T: A Foundation Model for Text-to-Structured 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30429)
*Liang Wang,Zhaoyang Xi,Zekai Xiang,Heng Meng,Qishan Zhang,Pingyi Zhou,Jin Liu,Litao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Arko-T是一个40亿参数的文字到设计模型，能够将自然语言直接转化为可执行的参数化CAD程序，通过设计状态对齐、数据整理、代码规范化和执行监督等手段保持CAD工件的可编辑性。在12项指标中，Arko-T以十分之一的成本取得了8项最佳和3项次佳成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Text-to-3D系统只能生成用于渲染的形状而非可编辑的设计，缺乏对设计状态（特征、参数、构造逻辑）的保留，无法满足工程编辑需求。

Method: 提出Arko-T，40亿参数文本到设计模型。通过设计状态对齐形式化概念，将数据整理、代码规范化和执行监督统一到同一目标下，确保CAD工件的特征、参数和构造逻辑得以保留。

Result: 与7个前沿大语言模型在12项指标上对比，Arko-T以十分之一的成本取得8项最佳、3项次佳成绩。

Conclusion: 中等规模的设计级专项训练能够在结构化CAD生成任务上匹敌甚至超越前沿通用模型，证明了设计导向训练策略的有效性。

Abstract: Text-to-3D systems can now synthesize a mechanical part from a single sentence, yet the result is a shape to render, not a design to edit. We present Arko-T, a 4B-parameter text-to-design model that maps natural-language intent directly into executable, parametric CAD programs. Rather than optimizing for code executability alone, Arko-T aligns every stage of the pipeline to a formal notion of design state, so that data curation, code normalization, and execution-grounded supervision all work to preserve the features, parameters, and construction logic that make a CAD artifact editable. Benchmarked against seven frontier LLMs across 12 metrics, Arko-T attains the best score on 8 and the second-best on 3 more, at roughly one-tenth the per-benchmark cost. The results suggest that targeted design-level training at moderate scale can match frontier general-purpose models on structured CAD generation.

</details>


### [409] [Transformer Architectures as Complete Bayes Processes: A Formal Proof in the Measure-Theoretic Kernel Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30440)
*Haobo Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文完整形式化证明了当Transformer内部更新机制满足贝叶斯联合分布条件时，其前向计算等价于精确的贝叶斯后验推断。在测度论核框架下，从核心贝叶斯Transformer到完整多层堆栈，逐层证明了贝叶斯联合语义蕴含更新核几乎处处等于后验。还证明了softmax注意力机制诱导出键上的有效概率分布，建立了抽象核框架与具体注意力实现之间的桥梁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在形式化证明Transformer架构在满足特定条件下可以实现精确的贝叶斯后验推断，为理解Transformer的推理机制提供严格的数学基础。

Method: 采用测度论核框架，定义从核心贝叶斯Transformer到语义Transformer、完整Transformer块（QKV/注意力/残差/MLP流水线）再到多层堆栈的抽象层次结构，通过Radon-Nikodym微分推导显式贝叶斯公式并证明其归一化，证明softmax注意力机制在键上诱导出有效概率分布。

Result: 在每个抽象层次上证明：贝叶斯联合语义条件蕴含更新核几乎处处等于后验；softmax注意力机制诱导出键上的有效概率分布；完整Transformer块的前向计算在满足联合分布条件时等价于严格的贝叶斯后验更新。

Conclusion: 该框架不依赖马尔可夫核结构之外的任何架构假设，揭示了Transformer块可被证明为贝叶斯模型的显式条件，为理解Transformer的贝叶斯推断特性提供了严格的形式化基础。

Abstract: We present a complete formal proof that transformer architectures, when their internal update mechanisms satisfy a Bayes joint-distribution condition, implement exact Bayesian posterior inference. Working within the measure-theoretic kernel framework, we define a hierarchy of abstractions -- from the core Bayesian transformer, through semantic transformers with explicit update kernels, to full transformer blocks with QKV/attention/residual/MLP pipelines, and finally multilayer stacks -- and prove at each level that the Bayes joint semantics implies the update kernel equals the posterior almost everywhere. For the block-level architecture, we derive the explicit Bayes formula through Radon-Nikodym differentiation and prove its normalization. We additionally prove that the softmax attention mechanism induces a valid probability distribution over keys, establishing the bridge between the abstract kernel framework and concrete attention implementations. The framework makes no architectural assumptions beyond the Markov kernel structure and exposes explicit conditions under which a transformer block is provably Bayesian. In essence, when this joint distribution condition is satisfied, the forward computation of a Transformer is formally equivalent to a rigorous Bayesian posterior update.

</details>


### [410] [When Does Online Imitation Learning Help in LLM Post-Training? The Role of (Non-)Realizability Beyond Horizon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30445)
*Huaqing Zhang,Jingchu Gai,Juno Kim,Bingbin Liu,Andrej Risteski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了在线模仿学习优势源于误差累积的传统观点，提出在线交互的好处关键取决于设置是否可实现（即学生策略类能否表示专家策略）。在可实现条件下，离线IL已能达到专家水平；在不可实现条件下，离线IL存在信息论瓶颈，而在线IL即使在分布严重不匹配时也能实现高绩效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线模仿学习（特别是on-policy蒸馏）虽在实践中表现优于离线监督微调，但其优势来源缺乏原理性理解。本文旨在厘清在线交互何时以及为何能带来性能提升。

Method: 通过理论分析与实验验证相结合的方式：在可实现性条件下进行实证对比；在不可实现（设定错误）条件下进行信息论下界证明，并基于奖励函数提出设定错误的结构化刻画，证明在线IL在此条件下能取得高绩效。

Result: 1) 可实现条件下，离线IL即可匹配专家性能，在线IL无额外优势；2) 不可实现条件下，即使horizon H=1，离线IL也存在信息论瓶颈；3) 提出了一种基于奖励的设定错误结构化刻画，在此框架下在线IL能克服分布不匹配问题。

Conclusion: 在线模仿学习的优势并非源于误差累积的缓解，而是取决于任务是否可实现。在不可实现场景下，在线交互通过克服信息论瓶颈来提升性能，这为理解在线IL的优势提供了新的理论视角。

Abstract: Online imitation learning (IL), particularly on-policy distillation, has emerged as a strong LLM post-training approach, often outperforming offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Yet a principled understanding of when and why online interaction helps remains unclear. In this work, we challenge the view that error accumulation is the main source of online IL's advantage, and instead show that the benefits of online interaction depend critically on whether the setting is realizable, i.e., whether the student policy class can represent the expert policy. Under realizability, we empirically find that offline IL already matches expert performance. In contrast, in non-realizable (misspecified) settings, we prove that offline IL encounters an information-theoretic bottleneck even when horizon $H=1$, and propose a structural characterization of misspecification relative to the reward, under which online IL provably achieves high performance despite a large distributional mismatch between the expert and student policies.

</details>


### [411] [Internal-State Probes Read the Situation, Not the Action: Three Negative Results for Pre-Action Misalignment Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30449)
*Max Fomin,Elad David,Amit LeVi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统检验了基于模型内部表征的预动作监控方法，发现构造有效性、语义可读性和引导效应均无法通过泛化性与特异性检验，无法成为可靠的预动作监控器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索模型内部探针能否在有害文本或工具动作生成之前实现预动作监控，从而增强智能体系统的安全性。

Method: 在三个模型族（Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct的微调/基座方向、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在 unsafe prefill 最后一个token的探针、Gemma-3-27B-IT的情感概念向量投影与引导）上测试三种方法，并设计了预动作测试、跨域泛化与概念特异性控制检验。

Result: Qwen方向在区分微调与基座上AUC=1.000，但在0/143个预助理轮次和0/342个不安全轨迹预填充行中触发阈值；Llama特征解码提示域AUC=0.999，但最佳未来行为探针仅AUC=0.801且准确率提升+5.1pp，六对有序跨域迁移中有五对非正；Gemma情感投影语义有意义，但在首个不同输入前状态不可区分，且引导特异性被无关方向（猫、天气、体育、地理）削弱。

Conclusion: 监控声明必须同时通过场景/动作泛化与概念特异性控制检验，目前尚无方法能成为鲁棒的预动作监控器。

Abstract: Probes on model internals could help monitor agentic systems if they identify harmful text or tool actions before those actions are generated. We ask when an internal readout supports this stronger pre-action claim, rather than merely describing the prompt, construction contrast, or current trajectory. We test three methods across three model families: a Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct fine-tune/base direction, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct probes at the last token of unsafe prefills, and Gemma-3-27B-IT emotion-concept vectors used for projection and steering in a blackmail tool-action scenario. Across these cases, construction validity, semantic legibility, and steering effects do not become robust pre-action monitors: each is undercut by a generalization or specificity check. The Qwen direction separates fine-tune from base at AUC 1.000, yet crosses its threshold on 0/143 audited pre-assistant turn contexts and on 0/342 Qwen prefill rows where the model continues the unsafe trajectory. The Llama features decode prompt domain almost perfectly (AUC 0.999), while the best future-behavior probe reaches AUC 0.801 and only +5.1 pp accuracy lift over majority; single-source cross-domain transfer is non-positive on five of six ordered pairs. Gemma emotion projections are semantically meaningful, but a shared-prefix minimal pair has indistinguishable states before the first differing input, and steering specificity weakens against unrelated learned directions such as cats}, weather, sports, and geography. We contribute a methodology for converting internal-readout claims into pre-action tests, and report scoped negative results: monitor claims must survive both scenario/action generalization and concept-specificity controls. Code is released at https://github.com/maxf-zn/misalignment_monitoring

</details>


### [412] [Exploring Differences Between Tabular Enterprise Data and Public Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30452)
*Myung Jun Kim,Maximilian Schambach,Frank Essenberger,Andre Sres,Johannes Höhne*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了企业表格数据与传统基准数据存在显著差异，在传统基准上表现良好的表格模型（如TabPFN、TabICL、ConTextTab）在企业真实数据上表现不佳，反之亦然，凸显了建立企业级基准测试的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业表格数据是业务运营的核心，但现有表格数据基准测试缺乏对企业数据特性的关注，导致模型在实际企业应用中的表现未知。

Method: 通过对企业数据的统计分析和多个表格模型（TabPFN、TabICL、ConTextTab）的性能测量，对比企业数据与典型表格基准的差异。

Result: 企业数据与传统表格基准在数据统计特性上存在显著差异；在传统基准上表现良好的模型在企业数据上可能表现差，反之亦然。

Conclusion: 现有表格模型缺乏从传统基准到企业数据的泛化能力，亟需构建具有企业级特征的额外基准测试。

Abstract: Tabular data dominate the landscape of data science, increasingly attracting innovative machine learning models and tailored benchmarks. Yet, little is known for enterprise data, where tables constitute the backbone of business operations. To broaden the benchmarking landscape for business applications, this work aims to actualize the characteristics of enterprise data by providing an analysis of data statistics and performance measurements of tabular models such as TabPFN, TabICL and ConTextTab. Through our analysis, we find enterprise data markedly differ from tabular benchmarks and we demonstrate that a tabular model that performs well on typical tabular benchmarks may perform poorly on real world enterprise data -- and vice versa. This lack of generalization underlines the need for additional benchmarks with enterprise-grade characteristics.

</details>


### [413] [HSAP: A Hierachical Sequence-aware Parallelism for Hybrid-Context Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30460)
*Songxin Zhang,Zejian Xie,Zhuoyang Song,Cong lin,Junyu Lu,Jiaxing Zhang,Bingyi Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种序列感知并行算法（Sequence-Aware Parallelism），通过JIT编译优化通信策略，解决混合上下文打包序列中的因果注意力计算问题，并构建了层次化并行框架，在多项指标上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列并行范式在处理混合上下文打包序列时无法正确计算因果注意力，存在跨污染问题；现有方法要么忽略混合上下文场景，要么牺牲并行度来支持该场景。

Method: 提出序列感知并行算法，利用JIT编译在NCCL层面优化多设备组的通信策略；将现有序列并行范式整合为层次化序列感知并行框架，并优化其内存与通信开销管理。

Result: 通过多项实验证明，所提方法在多个指标上优于现有的最先进序列并行方法。

Conclusion: 本文成功结合了现有序列并行的优势，克服了其无法正确处理混合上下文打包序列中因果注意力的缺陷，提出了一种更强、更高效的序列并行框架。

Abstract: In this paper, we aim to combine the advantages of existing sequence parallelism paradigms and overcomes their drawbacks, the most serious of which is the incapability to correctly compute causal attention on the hybrid-context packed sequences, in a stronger sequence parallelism framework. The practical technique of packing sequences for efficiently pretraining and fine-tuning large language models causes cross-contamination problem in attention computation, which can be effectively solved when no parallelism in the sequence length dimension is taken. However, in sequence parallelism, existing approaches either ignore the scenario of hybrid-context sequences or conversely sacrifice and limit parallelism degree for supporting the scenario. To this end, we innovatively propose an efficient Sequence-Aware Parallelism algorithm to conquer the obstacles of intensive tensor transmission and partial attention computation across multiple device groups. Our algorithm utilizes JIT (Just-In-Time) compilation to optimize the communication strategy of all device groups in NCCL level. Further, we integrate existing sequence parallelism paradigms into a Hierachical Sequence-Aware Parallelism framework which benefits from our sequence-aware algorithm. We additionally elaborate on the memory and communication overhead management of the hierachical framework to optimize its performance. Through multiple experiments, we demonstrate that our proposed approach outperform other state-of-the-arts sequence parallelism approches in multiple metrics.

</details>


### [414] [MuonSSM: Orthogonalizing State Space Models for Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30461)
*Thai-Khanh Nguyen,Ngoc-Bich-Uyen Vo,Thieu N. Vo,Tan M. Nguyen,Cuong Pham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MuonSSM 通过动量路径和低秩输入注入上的轻量级牛顿-舒尔茨变换来显式调节记忆更新的几何结构，从而稳定 SSM 训练，改善梯度传播、减轻频谱放大并丰富长程记忆表示，在语言、视觉和时间序列基准测试中取得一致性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SSM 因一阶更新条件不良和更新几何不平衡，在长程序列上存在不稳定性和记忆退化问题。

Method: 提出 MuonSSM 框架，通过动量路径和低秩输入注入上的轻量级牛顿-舒尔茨变换，显式调节记忆更新的几何结构，而非调节循环转移矩阵，在保持并行扫描复杂度的同时实现有界且谱条件良好的更新。

Result: 在语言、视觉和时间序列基准测试中，集成到多种 SSM 主干网络后，在准确性、鲁棒性和长上下文性能上均取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 更新几何的条件化是通向稳定、可扩展序列建模的原则性路径。

Abstract: State space models (SSMs) have emerged as efficient linear-time alternatives to attention for long-sequence modeling. However, existing SSMs often suffer from instability and memory degradation over extended horizons due to poorly conditioned first-order updates and unbalanced update geometry. We introduce MuonSSM, a general framework that stabilizes SSM training by explicitly conditioning the geometry of memory updates rather than the recurrent transition matrix. MuonSSM augments SSMs with a momentum-based pathway and a lightweight Newton Schulz transformation on low-rank input injections, yielding bounded and spectrally conditioned updates while preserving parallel scan complexity. Theory shows that MuonSSM improves gradient propagation, mitigates spectral amplification, and enriches memory representations over long horizons. Extensive experiments across language, vision, and time-series benchmarks show consistent gains in accuracy, robustness, and long-context performance when integrated into diverse SSM backbones. These results establish geometric conditioning of updates as a principled pathway to stable, scalable sequence modeling.

</details>


### [415] [Discovering Collaboration from Novelty: Random Network Distillation for Clustered Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30499)
*Davide Domini,Gianluca Aguzzi,Ivana Dusparic,Danilo Pianini,Mirko Viroli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于随机网络蒸馏（RND）的轻量级聚类联邦学习方法，通过客户端本地RND预测器的误差作为新颖性信号来估计客户端间的相似性，从而在联邦训练前发现有意义的客户端分组，解耦了聚类与学习过程，适用于非独立同分布数据下的自主大规模分布式系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在非独立同分布数据下表现不佳，单一全局模型难以代表客户端分布的多样性。现有聚类联邦学习方法将聚类分配与主训练循环耦合，增加了计算和通信开销。

Method: 每个客户端在本地数据上训练一个紧凑的随机网络蒸馏（RND）预测器，利用其预测误差作为新颖性信号来估计与其他客户端的相似性。在联邦训练开始前发现有意义的客户端分组，无需共享原始数据或反复评估主模型。

Result: 方法能够在运行时从局部新颖性估计中自发形成联邦分组，适用于既无法预先指定聚类数量也无法指定协作结构的自主大规模分布式系统。

Conclusion: 通过解耦聚类与学习，该方法提供了一种任务无关且高效的机制，用于在非独立同分布数据下实现自主协作。

Abstract: Federated Learning often suffers under non-independently and identically distributed data, where a single global model may fail to represent the diversity of client distributions. Clustered Federated Learning mitigates this issue by training specialized models for groups of similar clients, but existing approaches often couple cluster assignment with the main training loop, increasing computational and communication costs. We propose a lightweight clustering approach based on Random Network Distillation. Each client trains a compact Random Network Distillation predictor on its local data and uses its prediction error as a novelty signal to estimate similarity with other clients. This enables the discovery of meaningful client groups before federated training, without sharing raw data or repeatedly evaluating the main model. Crucially, the resulting federations emerge from local novelty estimates at runtime, making the method suitable for autonomous large-scale distributed systems where neither the number of clusters nor the collaboration structure can be specified a priori. Overall, by decoupling clustering from learning, the method provides a task-agnostic and efficient mechanism for autonomous collaboration under non-independently and identically distributed data.

</details>


### [416] [Muon learns balanced solutions in matrix factorization without slow saddle-to-saddle dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30509)
*Mark Rhee,Jamie Simon,Dhruva Karkada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了Muon优化器在矩阵分解问题中的动力学特性，揭示了其与梯度下降的三个关键差异：避免慢速鞍点间动力学、超越临界学习率稳定性、以及独特的守恒量。研究发现Muon能够实现快速收敛和指数级学习率退火，并利用其结构性质设计了仅需两步优化即可达到近乎完美对齐的学习率调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Muon优化器在非线性参数动力学和表示学习中的工作机制，特别是与梯度下降的差异，以解释其在实际深度学习任务中的优越表现。

Method: 以矩阵分解为最小学习问题，从动力学角度分析Muon优化器的参数轨迹，通过理论推导和实验验证三种主要动力学差异，包括收敛速度、稳定性边界和守恒量特征。

Result: 1) Muon避免从小初始化出发的慢速鞍点间动力学，以相同速率学习所有主模态，较小模态先收敛；2) Muon在学习率超过局部损失尖锐度临界阈值时仍保持稳定，使学习率不受问题条件数限制，实现指数级学习率退火的快速收敛；3) Muon流守恒$\sqrt{\mathbf{P}^\top \mathbf{P}}-\sqrt{\mathbf{Q}^\top \mathbf{Q}}$，而梯度流守恒$\mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{Q}^\top\mathbf{Q}$，两者从零初始化均能找到平衡解；4) 推导了简单设置下的对齐速率，能够预测一般情况下的经验对齐速率；5) 利用Muon的结构性质构造了仅需两步优化即可达到近乎完美对齐的学习率调度。

Conclusion: Muon优化器在矩阵分解中展现出与梯度下降本质不同的动力学特性，这些特性解释了其在实际深度学习中的有效性，特别是学习率不受条件数限制和快速对齐能力，为设计更高效的优化算法提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Matrix factorization (i.e., problems of the form $\min_{\mathbf{P},\mathbf{Q}} \|\mathbf{M}^\star - \mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{Q}\|_\mathrm{F}^2$) is a minimal learning problem that exhibits both nonlinear parameter dynamics and representation learning. In this setting, we study how parameter trajectories under the Muon optimizer differ from those of gradient descent. We identify three main dynamical differences: 1) Muon avoids the slow saddle-to-saddle dynamics from small initialization. Muon instead learns all the top modes of $\mathbf{M}^\star$ at the same rate, with the smaller modes converging first. 2) Muon remains stable even when the learning rate exceeds the critical threshold set by the local loss sharpness. This frees the learning rate from the condition number of the problem, enabling rapid convergence via exponential learning rate annealing. 3) Once the weights are aligned with each other and the target, Muon flow conserves the matrix quantity $\sqrt{\mathbf{P}^\top \mathbf{P}}-\sqrt{\mathbf{Q}^\top \mathbf{Q}}$, while gradient flow is known to conserve the matrix $\mathbf{P}^\top\mathbf{P} - \mathbf{Q}^\top\mathbf{Q}$. Despite having distinct conserved quantities, both optimizers find the so-called \textit{balanced} solution from vanishing initialization. When training from small random initialization, the weights spontaneously align early in training. We derive the alignment rates in simple settings and show that they predict the empirical alignment rates in general. Finally, we exploit structural properties of Muon to construct a learning rate schedule that achieves near-perfect alignment in only two optimization steps.

</details>


### [417] [Informational Frustration in Neural Manifolds: Shannon Bottlenecks and the Limits of Learnability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30512)
*Srinivasa Rao P.,Vangmayi P Reddy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出熵可学习性边界（ELH）定理，统一信息论、拓扑学与统计力学，解释了过参数化深度网络的泛化能力。通过香农-拓扑瓶颈定理揭示了"信息挫折"相变导致记忆化而非泛化的机制，将"顿悟"现象解释为熵释放，并提出了熵梯度下降（EGD）算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典学习理论（VC维、Rademacher复杂度）预测过参数化网络应严重过拟合，但实际模型泛化出奇地好，这一理论与现实间的巨大鸿沟亟待弥合。

Method: 构建了信息论（Shannon熵）、拓扑学（决策边界的拓扑熵）与统计力学（权重的von Neumann熵）的统一框架，推导出香农-拓扑瓶颈定理，定义熵可学习性边界（ELH）作为学习的基本物理定律。

Result: 证明了当目标边界的几何复杂度超过信息视界时，系统经历熵相变进入"信息挫折"（玻璃态刚性记忆化阶段），泛化在热力学意义上不可能；同时解释了"顿悟"（grokking）现象的本质是熵释放。

Conclusion: 提出熵梯度下降（EGD）算法动态管理权重熵以维持学习，将熵重新定位为决定机器能否学习的根本物理量。

Abstract: Why overparameterised deep networks generalise so remarkably well remains one of the most stubborn open questions in machine learning theory. Classical frameworks like VC dimension and Rademacher complexity predict catastrophic overfitting in modern models, leaving a massive theoretical gap between theory and reality. In this paper, we bridge this divide by introducing a unified framework that links information theory, topology, and statistical mechanics to map the hard limits of deep learning. Central to our approach is the Entropic Learnability Horizon (ELH): a fundamental law stating that a network can only truly learn a target function if the Shannon entropy of the data manifold outpaces the topological entropy of the function's decision boundary, balanced by the von Neumann entropy of the network's weight space. We establish the Shannon-Topological Bottleneck Theorem, proving that when a target boundary's geometric complexity exceeds this informational horizon, the system undergoes a sudden entropic phase transition. It falls into a state of Informational Frustration - a glassy, rigid memorization phase where generalization becomes thermodynamically impossible. Using this lens, we show that the enigmatic phenomenon of "grokking" is actually an Entropic Release, where weights abruptly reorganise to unlock the bottleneck. Finally, we translate this theory into practice with Entropic Gradient Descent (EGD), an optimization algorithm that dynamically manages weight entropy to keep learning on track. Ultimately, this work repositions entropy not just as a tool for tracking uncertainty but as the fundamental physical currency that dictates whether a machine can learn.

</details>


### [418] [ITSPACE: Monotone Gaussian Optimal Transport Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30523)
*Woojoo Na,Jennifer Dy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ITSPACE方法，通过近端主化-最小化算法直接优化Bures-Wasserstein目标，在平方根分解下实现闭式更新，从而高效对齐协方差矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协方差矩阵作为特征分布的紧凑描述子在许多机器学习管道（如域适应、高斯嵌入）中广泛使用，但在Wasserstein-2最优传输框架下，直接优化Bures-Wasserstein目标存在计算效率问题，现有方法要么依赖于梯度下降收敛慢，要么采用正则化近似损失精度。

Method: 提出ITSPACE方法，一种近端主化-最小化算法，直接在协方差的平方根分解空间中进行闭式更新，每一步都保证Bures-Wasserstein目标的充分下降；针对非精确极分解，给出了显式的证书间隙界来控制偏离程度。

Result: 在真实协方差对齐基准测试中，ITSPACE相比BW梯度下降、基于其他协方差几何的方法以及熵正则化样本OT基线，能以更快速度达到低BW-gap解。

Conclusion: ITSPACE作为轻量级内循环原语，特别适用于在严格的步数和计算预算下从无标签目标批次进行适配的场景，通过构造保持PSD结构并自然支持秩受限因子。

Abstract: Covariance matrices serve as compact descriptors of feature distributions in many machine-learning pipelines, including domain adaptation and Gaussian embeddings. Under a centered Gaussian approximation, the unregularized Wasserstein-2 optimal-transport (OT) discrepancy admits a closed form on covariances given by the Bures-Wasserstein (BW) objective on the symmetric positive definite (SPD) cone. We propose ITSPACE (Iterative Transport for Stable Proximal Alignment of Covariance Embeddings), a proximal majorization-minimization method that directly optimizes this exact BW objective through closed-form updates in a square-root factorization. In exact arithmetic, each iteration satisfies a sufficient-decrease inequality for the BW objective; under inexact polar computations, we provide an explicit certificate-gap bound controlling deviations from exact descent. The resulting iterations preserve PSD structure by construction and naturally support rank-restricted factors, making ITSPACE well-suited as a lightweight inner-loop primitive in settings where adaptation must be performed from unlabeled target batches under strict step and compute budgets. Across real-world covariance-alignment benchmarks, ITSPACE reaches low-BW-gap solutions substantially faster than BW-gradient descent, methods based on other covariance geometries, and entropically regularized sample-OT baselines.

</details>


### [419] [TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30560)
*Kan Zhu,Mathew Jacob,Chenxi Ma,Yi Pan,Stephanie Wang,Arvind Krishnamurthy,Baris Kasikci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文收集并发布了约4,300个编码智能体会话（包含35万LLM步骤和43万工具调用）的真实工作负载轨迹，分析发现编码智能体工作负载具有长自主循环、长上下文短输出、多样化工具调用以及高但不完美的前缀缓存命中率等特征，并据此提出了多项服务优化方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前编码智能体正成为LLM智能体的重要应用，但缺乏真实工作负载数据来支撑服务系统的优化研究。现有公开轨迹和基准无法反映多智能体、多模型家族的真实日常使用模式，亟需填补这一空白。

Method: 收集了来自Claude Code和Codex日常使用的约4,300个编码智能体会话，包含约35万LLM步骤和43万工具调用，并对数据进行了特征分析。

Result: 编码智能体工作负载呈现四大特征：长自主循环、长上下文短输出、多样化且长尾分布的工具调用、高但不完美的前缀缓存命中率。

Conclusion: 基于发现的负载特征，提出了多项服务优化方向：降低工具调用开销、追加长度感知的预填充、语义感知的工具延迟预测、以及围绕人工操作间隙改进KV缓存管理。

Abstract: Coding agents are rapidly becoming a major application of agentic LLMs, but serving them efficiently remains challenging. Progress on this challenge requires understanding real workload patterns, yet the data needed for such analysis is largely absent. Existing public traces and benchmarks do not capture real, day-to-day coding-agent usage across multiple agents and model families for serving-system analysis. To help fill this gap, we collect and release a trace of roughly 4,300 coding-agent sessions, containing about 350,000 LLM steps and 430,000 tool calls from our own day-to-day use of Claude Code and Codex. Our analysis shows that coding-agent workloads feature long autonomous loops, long contexts with short outputs, diverse and heavily-tailed tool calls, and high but imperfect prefix cache hit rates. These findings point to concrete opportunities for optimizing serving, including lower-overhead tool calling, append-length-aware prefill, semantic-aware tool-latency prediction, and improved KV-cache management around human-paced gaps. We release the dataset, trace collection pipeline, and analysis code at https://github.com/uw-syfi/TraceLab.git; the project website is https://tracelab.cs.washington.edu.

</details>


### [420] [SWE-INTERACT: Reimagining SWE Benchmarks as User-Driven Long-Horizon Coding Sessions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30573)
*Mohit Raghavendra,Anisha Gunjal,Aakash Sabharwal,Yunzhong He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SWE-Interact是一个评估编码智能体在多轮、交互式、用户驱动软件工程任务中的新测试平台。与一次性提供完整需求的基准不同，它模拟真实开发者工作流：用户模拟器从模糊指令开始逐步揭示需求、检查工作区并提供反馈。研究发现，在单轮SWE任务中表现优异的模型无法可靠迁移到多轮用户驱动场景（最佳模型单轮解决率~50%，多轮仅~25%），即使最强模型也存在过度自主编码、遗忘需求等技术问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SWE基准测试通常一次性提供完整需求并评估智能体的自主实现能力，但现实中的软件开发是迭代的、用户驱动的过程，用户需求往往模糊且逐步明确。因此需要一个新的测试平台来衡量智能体在交互式需求发现、渐进式精炼和用户协作方面的能力。

Method: 构建SWE-Interact测试平台，设计用户模拟器模拟真实开发者工作流：从模糊/不完整指令开始，逐步揭示需求，检查智能体工作区，提供针对性反馈、修改意见和新约束，直到任务目标完全达成。该设计基于大规模真实编码智能体交互研究。

Result: 前沿和开放权重模型在单轮SWE任务中的强表现无法可靠迁移到多轮用户驱动工作流：最佳模型解决约50%的单轮基线任务，但仅解决约25%的相应SWE-Interact任务。最强模型（如Opus 4.8、GPT 5.5）在模糊初始指令下表现良好，能坚持到需求完全揭示并编写干净代码，但仍存在过度自主编码、遗忘需求和技术错误问题。较弱模型在模糊性下表现差、过早放弃、遗忘或忽略指令、频繁重构代码。

Conclusion: SWE-Interact衡量了前沿模型开发中一个正交的、真实世界的能力轴：交互式目标发现和用户参与下的迭代精炼。多轮交互能力与单轮自主实现能力是不同维度的能力，需要分别评估和发展。

Abstract: We introduce SWE-Interact, a new testbed for evaluating coding agents on multi-turn, interactive, user-driven software engineering tasks. Existing frontier SWE benchmarks typically provide complete requirements upfront and evaluate agents on autonomous implementation. In contrast, SWE-Interact places agents in a realistic developer workflow: a carefully designed user simulator starts with vague or incomplete instructions, progressively reveals requirements, inspects the agent's workspace, and provides targeted feedback, revisions, and new constraints until the full task goal has been handed off. Grounded in large-scale studies of real coding-agent interactions, this setup tests whether agents can discover user intent, adapt to evolving requirements, and build on their own prior work. Across a suite of frontier and open-weight models, we find that strong performance on single-turn SWE tasks does not reliably transfer to multi-turn, user-driven workflows: the best-performing models solve roughly 50% of single-turn baseline tasks but only 25% of the corresponding SWE-Interact tasks. The strongest models in our evaluation, including Opus 4.8 and GPT 5.5, start strong even in the face of vague initial instructions, persevere until all the requirements are surfaced by the user, integrate them better and write clean code. However, they still suffer from over-agentic coding, forgetting requirements and technical mistakes. Weaker models start poorly under ambiguity, give up early, forget or ignore instructions and rework their code more. Overall, SWE-Interact measures an orthogonal, real-world capability axis for frontier model development: interactive goal discovery and iterative refinement with a user in the loop.

</details>


### [421] [The Fundamental Limits of Valid Transport Map Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30574)
*Sivaraman Balakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在极小极大框架下形式化了任意有效传输映射的估计任务，证明在标准稳定性假设下，估计任意有效传输映射与估计最优传输映射具有相同的统计难度（样本复杂度下界），同时指出当稳定性条件不成立时，次优传输映射可被更准确地学习，为现代基于传输的生成方法（如扩散模型、流匹配）提供了统计极限的理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型、归一化流和流匹配等现代生成方法估计的是分布之间的传输映射或计划，但并不明确追求最优传输（OT）映射。由于在生成建模等应用中传输成本本身并不重要，因此自然可以追求在统计或计算上更易处理的映射。本文旨在严格形式化任意有效传输映射的估计任务，并探讨其统计样本复杂度。

Method: 采用极小极大（minimax）统计框架，形式化定义任意有效传输映射的估计问题。通过建立样本复杂度下界，将流匹配和扩散模型等方法的统计难度与OT映射估计的难度进行比较分析。同时通过反例分析当OT稳定性假设不成立时的情形。

Result: 在OT文献中标准的（尽管较强）稳定性假设下，估计任意有效传输映射与估计OT映射在统计上具有相同的难度（相同的样本复杂度下界）。当这些稳定性条件不成立时，次优传输映射可以被显著更准确地学习。

Conclusion: 该极小极大框架为理解现代基于传输的生成方法的统计极限提供了严格基础，阐明了何时以及为何针对次优映射可以带来真实的统计优势。

Abstract: Many modern generative modeling methods, including diffusion models, normalizing flows, and flow matching, estimate transport maps or plans between distributions without explicitly targeting an optimal transport (OT) map. In applications like generative modeling, the transport cost itself is irrelevant, and this makes it natural to target maps which are more tractable from either a statistical or computational standpoint. In this short note, we formalize the task of estimating any valid transport map in a rigorous minimax framework. One consequence of this framing is that it yields sample complexity lower bounds for any method whose learned object is evaluated as a transport map or plan, including flow matching and diffusion-based generative models, in settings where direct analysis would be challenging due to the analytic complexity of the methods and their target maps. We observe that, under standard, though strong, stability assumptions from the OT literature, estimating any valid transport map is statistically as hard as estimating the OT map. We complement these results with some examples showing that when these stability assumptions fail, alternative transport maps can be learned substantially more accurately than the OT map. Our minimax framing provides a rigorous foundation for understanding the statistical limits of modern transport-based generative methods and clarifies when targeting sub-optimal maps can provide real statistical advantages.

</details>


### [422] [C$^{2}$R: Cross-sample Consistency Regularization Mitigates Feature Splitting and Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30609)
*Haoran Jin,Xiting Wang,Shijie Ren,Hong Xie,Defu Lian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对稀疏自编码器（SAE）在扩展字典时出现的特征分裂与特征吸收问题，本文提出跨样本一致性正则化（C²R），通过惩罚批处理中方向相似潜变量的共激活，迫使同一语义特征由统一潜变量一致表示，有效提升潜变量可解释性且不损害重建保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAE在大规模字典下存在特征分裂（将连贯概念碎片化为非原子潜变量）和特征吸收（在通用特征中制造任意例外）两大问题，严重损害潜变量的可靠性，其根源在于缺乏跨样本约束导致单一样本优化将同一概念不一致地分配到多个冗余或干扰潜变量中。

Method: 提出跨样本一致性正则化（C²R），通过惩罚批处理中方向相似潜变量的共激活，显式鼓励每个语义特征在整批样本中由统一潜变量一致表示。

Result: C²R有效缓解了特征分裂和特征吸收问题，同时保持重建保真度，增强了潜变量可解释性且不降低模型性能。

Conclusion: C²R为SAE的大规模字典扩展提供了一种有原则的解决方案，在不牺牲重建质量的前提下提升了潜变量的一致性和可解释性。

Abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret large language models by decomposing activations into sparse, human-understandable features, but scaling to large dictionaries exposes fundamental challenges. Systematic studies reveal pervasive feature splitting that fragments coherent concepts into non-atomic latents and widespread feature absorption that creates arbitrary exceptions in general features, severely compromising latent reliability. These issues stem from inconsistent latent assignment across samples: without cross-sample constraints, per-sample optimization often allows a single underlying concept to be inconsistently distributed across multiple redundant or interfering latents. To address this, we introduce C$^2$R (\underline{\textbf{C}}ross-sample \underline{\textbf{C}}onsistency \underline{\textbf{R}}egularization). C$^2$R explicitly encourages that each semantic feature is consistently represented by a unified latent across the batch by penalizing the co-activation of directionally similar latents. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that C$^2$R effectively mitigates both splitting and absorption while, crucially, preserving reconstruction fidelity, providing a principled solution that enhances latent interpretability without degrading model performance. Source code is available at https://github.com/hr-jin/Cross-sample-Consistency-Regularization.

</details>


### [423] [Pessimism's Paradox: Conservative Offline Training Amplifies Reward Hacking During Online Adaptation in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30627)
*Subramanyam Sahoo,Aman Chadha,Vinija Jain,Divya Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实验发现，在离线保守训练（如DPO）中，更高的保守度（β）反而会加剧后续在线适应中的奖励破解（reward hacking）问题。机制分析表明：高β压缩策略熵→低多样性响应→响应集中在奖励模型训练分布窄区域→但集成不确定性仍增加并被更快利用。作者提出需寻找校准的（而非最大的）保守度β*。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"离线保守训练是安全在线适应基础"这一广泛直觉，揭示高保守度可能导致更严重的奖励破解问题。

Method: 使用Qwen3-14B策略在DPO下以三种保守度（β_lo, β_mid, β_hi）训练，然后针对奖励模型集成（3×Qwen3-1.7B）进行在线适应，在GSM8K上测量真实性能。

Result: 更高离线保守度单调增加奖励破解损害（Spearman ρ=1.0）；机制为：高β压缩熵→降低输出多样性→响应集中于窄区域→但集成不确定性增加且被更快利用。

Conclusion: 需要校准的保守度而非最大保守度，存在一个平衡对齐保真度与破解脆弱性的最优保守度β*。

Abstract: Conservative offline training is widely advocated as a safe foundation for subsequent online adaptation: if a policy stays close to well-supported behaviour, the argument goes, it is less likely to exploit imperfections in a learned reward model. We challenge this intuition empirically and mechanistically. We train a Qwen3-14B policy under Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) with three levels of conservatism ($β\in \{β_{\mathrm{lo}}, β_{\mathrm{mid}}, β_{\mathrm{hi}}\}$ derived from empirical log-ratio percentiles), then adapt each checkpoint online against a learned reward ensemble (3\,$\times$\,Qwen3-1.7B) while measuring true performance on GSM8K exact-answer accuracy. We find that \emph{higher offline conservatism monotonically increases reward-hacking damage}, measured by the Goodhart gap and its area under the curve (AUGC), with Spearman $ρ= 1.0$ across all three conditions. Mechanistic analysis reveals a three-link causal chain: (i) high-$β$ DPO compresses policy entropy, (ii) Low-entropy policies generate responses with reduced diversity, concentrating in a narrow region of the reward model's training distribution (lower pairwise cosine distance), and (iii) despite this proximity, ensemble disagreement (epistemic uncertainty) increases with $β$ and is exploited faster during online optimisation. We further fit a power-law curve to the $(β, \augc)$ data and identify a practical optimal conservatism level $β^{\star}$ that balances alignment fidelity against hacking vulnerability. Our results suggest that the field needs \emph{calibrated}, not \emph{maximal}, conservatism.

</details>


### [424] [One-Step Gradient Delay is Not a Barrier for Large-Scale Asynchronous Pipeline Parallel LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30634)
*Philip Zmushko,Egor Petrov,Nursultan Abdullaev,Mikhail Khrushchev,Samuel Horváth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了异步流水线并行中一步梯度延迟必然导致不稳定的普遍观点，发现延迟影响高度依赖于优化器选择（AdamW退化严重，Muon鲁棒性强），并提出基于误差反馈的修正方法，在10B参数模型上验证了与同步训练性能相当的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步流水线并行（如PipeDream-2BW）可消除同步流水线中的气泡问题，最大化吞吐量，但由于梯度陈旧性导致的优化不稳定问题，其实际应用受限。本文旨在挑战“陈旧性必然导致不稳定”这一普遍假设。

Method: 1) 对PipeDream-2BW的一步延迟在不同优化器（AdamW vs Muon）下进行对比实验；2) 提出一种与优化器无关的基于误差反馈（Error Feedback）的修正策略来缓解延迟影响；3) 提供Muon在有无修正下的收敛理论分析。

Result: 1) AdamW在一步延迟下性能严重退化，而Muon表现出强鲁棒性；2) 提出的误差反馈修正可进一步缩小与同步训练的性能差距；3) 在10B参数模型上的大规模实验证实了该策略的有效性。

Conclusion: 异步流水线并行中一步梯度延迟的负面影响并非固有特性，而是取决于优化器选择。结合Muon和误差反馈修正，可以弥合异步与同步训练间的性能鸿沟，展示了异步流水线并行在大规模训练中的实用潜力。

Abstract: Modern large-scale LLM pretraining benefits from utilizing Pipeline Parallelism; however, synchronous implementations leave GPUs idle during pipeline bubbles, wasting computational resources. Asynchronous Pipeline Parallelism eliminates these bubbles, maximizing throughput at the cost of gradient staleness. Among asynchronous schedules, PipeDream-2BW is particularly appealing: unlike the original PipeDream schedule, it ensures a constant one-step gradient delay regardless of pipeline depth. However, its adoption remains limited due to the common belief that optimizing under staleness is fundamentally unstable. In this work, we challenge this assumption, demonstrating that degradation under one-step delay depends strongly on optimizer choice rather than being an intrinsic limitation. We provide the first comprehensive empirical analysis showing that while AdamW, the predominant optimizer at the time when PipeDream-2BW was introduced, indeed suffers from severe degradation, recent methods like Muon exhibit strong robustness under a one-step delay. We introduce an optimizer-agnostic Error Feedback-inspired correction to further mitigate delay effects. We provide supporting theoretical analysis demonstrating convergence for Muon with and without this correction. Extensive evaluation on models up to 10B parameters confirms that our strategies bridge the performance gap with synchronous training, highlighting the practical potential of asynchronous pipeline parallelism at scale.

</details>


<div id='math.OC'></div>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [425] [Comparing Scalar Objective Functions for Multi-Criteria Engineering Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28541)
*Olaf Frommann*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了双目标最小化问题中四种标量化方法（加权和、成就标量化函数、期望函数、模糊逻辑）在凸/凹Pareto前沿上的可达区域、参数选择密度、补偿性、敏感性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当多准则优化问题需要输出单一优选设计而非整个Pareto集时，必须使用标量目标函数。不同的标量化方法会影响妥协方案的选择、偏好参数的解读方式以及非支撑Pareto区域的可达性，因此需要系统比较各方法的特性。

Method: 使用两个解析定义的Pareto前沿（一个凸、一个凹），将目标函数公式化的影响与数值优化器行为隔离。比较四种标量化方法：加权和、成就标量化函数、期望函数和基于模糊逻辑的公式化。

Result: 加权和在凹前沿上存在结构性限制；成就标量化、期望函数和模糊公式通过不同机制可达到内部非支撑区域；期望函数引入非线性单准则偏好映射；模糊规则可表达非可分离和依赖参考点的工程偏好。

Conclusion: 不同标量化方法在可达Pareto区域、参数诱导的选择密度、准则间补偿性、敏感性和可解释性方面存在显著差异，需根据问题特性选择合适方法。

Abstract: Scalar objective functions are required when a multi-criteria optimization problem must yield a single preferred design rather than only a Pareto set. The choice of scalarization influences which compromise is selected, how preference parameters are interpreted, and whether non-supported Pareto regions can be reached. This paper compares four formulations for normalized bi-criteria minimization: weighted sums, achievement scalarizing functions, desirability functions, and a fuzzy-logic-based formulation. Two analytically defined Pareto fronts, one convex and one concave, isolate the effect of the objective formulation from numerical optimizer behavior. The comparison focuses on reachable Pareto regions, parameter-induced selection density, compensation between criteria, sensitivity, and interpretability. Results show that weighted sums are simple but structurally limited on concave fronts, while achievement, desirability, and fuzzy formulations reach interior non-supported regions through different mechanisms. Desirability functions introduce nonlinear single-criterion preference mappings, whereas fuzzy rules express nonseparable and reference-dependent engineering preferences.

</details>


### [426] [A New Noise Model for Data-driven Control: Generalized Frobenius Norm Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28557)
*Huayuan Huang,M. Kanat Camlibel,Henk J. van Waarde*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的数据驱动控制噪声模型，该模型可解释为噪声样本矩阵Frobenius范数界的推广。对于瞬时有界噪声，该模型比基于二次矩阵不等式(QMI)的现有噪声模型具有更小的保守性。利用新模型，推导了数据驱动控制的充要条件，涵盖二次镇定、H2控制、H∞控制等设计问题，并扩展至数据驱动分析问题。关键技术贡献是一种新的S引理，用于刻画向量化变量的二次不等式蕴含二次矩阵不等式的充要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动控制的噪声模型在处理瞬时有界噪声时存在保守性过强的问题，需要一种更精确的噪声建模方法以降低保守性并得到充要的控制条件。

Method: 提出一种新的噪声模型（Frobenius范数界的推广形式），推导与之对应的S引理，基于该引理建立数据驱动控制和分析的充要条件框架。

Result: 新模型在瞬时有界噪声下比QMI模型保守性更低；获得了二次镇定、H2控制、H∞控制的充要条件；将框架扩展至可镇定性、耗散性等分析问题。

Conclusion: 所提噪声模型和S引理为数据驱动控制提供了更紧且充要的理论基础，适用于广泛的控制与分析问题。

Abstract: In this article, we introduce a new noise model for data-driven control. The model can be interpreted as a generalization of a Frobenius norm bound on the matrix of noise samples. For instantaneously bounded noise, the proposed model provides a less conservative overapproximation than an existing noise model based on a quadratic matrix inequality (QMI). Using the new model, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for data-driven control. The framework covers a broad class of design problems, including quadratic stabilization, $\mathcal{H}_2$ control and $\mathcal{H}_{\infty}$ control, and is further extended to cover data-driven analysis problems, ranging for stabilizability to dissipativity. A key technical contribution is a new type of S-lemma that offers necessary and sufficient conditions under which a quadratic matrix inequality is implied by a quadratic inequality in vectorized variables.

</details>


### [427] [A Relaxation and Rectification (ReCR) Framework for Systems with Linear and Complementary Constraints: Theoretical Foundation, Algorithms and Numerical Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28563)
*Wissam AlAli,Xin Jiang,Jiming Peng*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对线性互补约束系统（SLCC）的可行性问题，提出了通用松弛理论（URT）将其等价转化为提升空间中的双线性优化问题，并开发了松弛-纠正（ReCR）框架用于求解或证明不可行性。实验表明所提方法在多种规模的LCP和SLCC实例上高效可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SLCC广泛存在于工程、经济及优化模型（如双线性优化、二次约束优化）的最优性条件中，但求解SLCC的可行性问题在一般情况下是NP难的，现有方法在可靠性与可扩展性上存在不足，亟需更系统的理论框架和高效算法。

Method: 提出通用松弛理论（URT），将SLCC可行性问题等价转化为提升空间中的双线性优化问题；推导了该双线性模型全局解的必要与充分最优性条件；基于此设计松弛-纠正（ReCR）框架，包含多种不同工作空间和子问题公式的具体方法并分析收敛性；针对ReCR方法未找到可行解的情况，设计了不可行性证明的数值程序。

Result: 在文献中的小规模和大规模LCP实例上，所提ReCR方法通常仅需少数迭代即可找到可行解；在更具挑战性的中等规模SLCC实例基准上，混合ReCR（H-ReCR）方法表现出竞争力。

Conclusion: 提出的URT理论和ReCR框架为求解SLCC可行性问题提供了系统性的理论支撑和高效实用的算法工具，具有良好的可靠性、鲁棒性和可扩展性，尤其在中等规模问题上表现突出。

Abstract: Systems defined by linear and complementarity constraints (SLCCs) arise frequently in engineering, economics, and other related fields. They also appear in the optimality conditions of many challenging optimization models, such as bilinear optimization and linearly constrained quadratic optimization. It is known that finding a feasible solution to an SLCC is NP-hard in general. In this paper, we study the feasibility problem for a given SLCC: either find a feasible solution or determine that the system is infeasible. To this end, we introduce a universal relaxation theory (URT), which reformulates SLCC feasibility as an equivalent bilinear optimization problem with linear constraints in a lifted space. We then analyze the resulting bilinear model and derive necessary and sufficient optimality conditions for its global solutions. Based on these theoretical insights, we introduce a relaxation-rectification (ReCR) framework for finding a feasible solution to a given SLCC instance or certifying infeasibility. We develop several ReCR methods that differ in their working spaces and subproblem formulations and analyze their convergence properties. We also develop a numerical procedure for obtaining an infeasibility certificate when the ReCR methods do not find a feasible solution.
  We conduct numerical experiments to evaluate the reliability, robustness, and scalability of the proposed ReCR methods and compare them with existing SLCC solvers. On the tested small- and large-scale LCP instances from the literature, the proposed ReCR methods typically find feasible solutions in a few iterations. We also extend the benchmark with more challenging medium-scale SLCC instances, on which the proposed hybrid ReCR (H-ReCR) method exhibits promising performance.

</details>


### [428] [Robust Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics via Least Trimmed Squares](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28584)
*Fabio Amaral,Geovani N. Grapiglia,Cassio M. Oishi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合迭代最小修剪二乘（ILTS）和序列阈值最小二乘（STLS）的鲁棒SINDy管道（ILTS-SINDy），用于在噪声和异常值存在下恢复稀疏动力学模型，在高达20%观测值被污染的情况下仍保持良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SINDy方法在数据被噪声和异常值（离群点）污染时性能严重下降，而现有的鲁棒SINDy变体在处理高比例异常值时仍然不够有效。

Method: 将异常值滤波与稀疏回归解耦，先通过ILTS迭代最小化最小的平方残差和来识别最可靠的观测数据（无需事先知道异常值），再使用STLS恢复稀疏的控制方程。

Result: 大量数值实验表明，ILTS-SINDy在多种异常值污染水平下显著优于现有鲁棒SINDy变体，即使在高达20%观测值被污染的情况下仍能保持性能。

Conclusion: ILTS-SINDy提供了一种有效的鲁棒稀疏动力学识别方案，能够在数据被严重污染时准确恢复稀疏模型。

Abstract: In this work, we propose a robust Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) pipeline for handling datasets corrupted by noise and outliers. The method decouples outlier filtering from sparse regression by combining Iterative Least Trimmed Squares (ILTS) with Sequentially Thresholded Least Squares (STLS). Unlike standard approaches that treat all observations uniformly within a single regression stage, the proposed ILTS-SINDy framework first applies an ILTS procedure that iteratively minimizes the sum of the smallest squared residuals to identify the most reliable observations without prior knowledge of outliers, after which STLS is used to recover a parsimonious governing model. Extensive numerical experiments show that ILTS-SINDy can significantly outperform existing robust SINDy variants across a range of outlier contamination levels, with performance maintained even under settings with up to $20\%$ corrupted observations.

</details>


### [429] [Lipschitz Regularity in Wasserstein Robust Stochastic Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28633)
*Shengbo Wang,Jose Blanchet*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了Wasserstein鲁棒随机最优控制在无界Polish状态空间上的Lipschitz正则性，证明两种鲁棒公式（核鲁棒和噪声鲁棒）下，Lipschitz模型原语能导出Lipschitz鲁棒值函数，而非鲁棒设定下这一性质不成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究鲁棒值函数的正则性（Lipschitz连续性）是否足以支持近似和学习，这是鲁棒随机最优控制中的重要基础问题。

Method: 考虑两种鲁棒公式：核鲁棒模型（对抗扰动下一状态分布在名义转移核的Wasserstein球内）和噪声鲁棒模型（对抗扰动驱动噪声）。在无限时域折扣奖励准则下分析值函数的Lipschitz正则性。

Result: 与经典非鲁棒设定中Lipschitz奖励和Lipschitz转移动态不能保证Lipschitz值函数不同，Wasserstein鲁棒公式下Lipschitz模型原语可导出Lipschitz鲁棒值函数。

Conclusion: Wasserstein鲁棒性不仅防护模型误配，还正则化了Bellman不动点，为离散化、值函数逼近、估计和学习提供了稳定性。

Abstract: Robust Markov decision processes provide a principled framework for protecting sequential decision-making against transition-law misspecification and have attracted substantial recent research interest. As in non-robust stochastic optimal control, an important question is whether the robust value function is sufficiently regular for approximation and learning. This paper studies Lipschitz regularity of optimal value functions for Wasserstein robust stochastic optimal control on possibly unbounded Polish state spaces under an infinite-horizon discounted reward criterion. We consider two robustness formulations: a kernel-robust model, in which the adversary perturbs the next-state distribution within a Wasserstein ball around a nominal transition kernel, and a noise-robust model, in which the adversary perturbs the driving noise of the state transition dynamics. In the non-robust setting, Lipschitz rewards and Lipschitz transition dynamics do not, in general, imply a Lipschitz value function. In contrast, we show that in these Wasserstein robust formulations, Lipschitz assumptions on the model primitives yield Lipschitz robust value functions. Thus, Wasserstein robustness not only protects against misspecification but also regularizes the Bellman fixed point, providing stability relevant to discretization, value-function approximation, estimation, and learning.

</details>


### [430] [Optimal control of diffusive mean-field models for swarming particles on the sphere](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28886)
*Jinwook Jung,Dohyun Kim*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了单位球面上带扩散的共识（高维Kuramoto型）动力学均值场最优控制问题，建立了微观N粒子Liouville问题的最优控制存在性，证明了固定控制下单粒子边际以O(1/√N)速率收敛到均值场解，并证明了微观最优控制弱极限是均值场问题的最优控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高维共识动力学中引入扩散和最优控制，建立从微观粒子层面对均值场控制的严格逼近理论。

Method: 通过N粒子Liouville问题建模微观控制，利用随机均值场极限证明收敛速率，采用弱极限方法建立微观与均值场最优控制的联系。

Result: 证明了微观最优控制的存在性；固定控制下单粒子边际以O(1/√N)收敛到均值场解；微观最优控制的弱极限是均值场问题的最优控制。

Conclusion: 微观层次的最优控制可以在均值场极限下近似均值场最优控制，为高维共识动力学的分散式控制提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We study a mean-field optimal control problem for a consensus (high-dimensional Kuramoto-type) dynamics with diffusion on the unit sphere. The control acts through a prescribed drift field and an interaction gain, and the cost functional is given to track a given target density while penalizing the control effort. At the microscopic level, we formulate the corresponding controlled $N$-particle Liouville problem and establish the existence of optimal controls. For fixed controls, we obtain a quantitative stochastic mean-field limit showing that the one-particle marginal converges to the mean-field solution with the convergence rate $\mathcal O(1/\sqrt{N})$. Finally, we show that microscopic optimal controls approximate a mean-field optimal control: any weak limit of particle-level minimizers is optimal for the mean-field problem.

</details>


### [431] [Distributed recursive binary identification under tampering and non-persistent excitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28913)
*Jian Guo,Ji-Feng Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对测量端篡改（二进制观测标签可能被翻转）下的分布式参数估计问题，提出了一种基于扩散策略的分布式递归投影算法，并在无独立性、平稳性或高斯假设下，建立了自适应预测器累积遗憾和分布式估计误差的几乎必然上界。在温和的协作激励条件下，即使每个节点单独非激励，所有节点的估计也能实现一致性。仿真表明该算法收敛，而非协作和未察觉篡改的基线算法则发散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式参数估计方法多假设观测数据干净或未被篡改，但实际系统中传感数据可能被恶意翻转（如测量端篡改攻击）。如何在二进制观测标签可能被篡改且无统计假设（独立性、平稳性、高斯性）的条件下，实现分布式一致估计，是本文的核心动机。

Method: 基于扩散策略（diffusion strategy）设计分布式递归投影算法；每个节点本地采用递归投影更新，并通过邻居信息交换实现协作；理论分析利用鞅论和随机逼近工具，在协作激励条件下建立几乎必然收敛性。

Result: 证明了自适应预测器的累积遗憾和分布式估计误差的几乎必然上界；在协作激励条件下，所有节点估计一致且一致收敛；仿真验证了算法在联合激励网络中的有效性，而对比的非协作和未察觉篡改基线发散。

Conclusion: 本文提出的分布式递归投影算法能在二进制观测标签被篡改且无统计假设的挑战环境下实现一致估计，为抗篡改的分布式参数估计提供了理论保证和可行方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we consider distributed parameter estimation with binary observations under measurement-side tampering: each node observes a thresholded output whose label may be flipped and exchanges information over a communication graph. We develop a distributed recursive projection algorithm based on the diffusion strategy. Without imposing independence, stationarity, or Gaussian assumptions, we establish almost sure upper bounds of both the accumulated regrets of the adaptive predictor and the distributed estimation error. Under a mild cooperative excitation condition, all nodes' estimate are consistent, even when each node is individually non-exciting. Simulations on a jointly exciting network corroborate the theory and show that the proposed algorithm converges, whereas non-cooperative and tampering-unaware baselines do not.

</details>


### [432] [Second-Order Sensitivity of Efficient Solution and Marginal Maps in Parametric Vector Optimization with Set Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28965)
*N. X. D. Bao,Tan H. Cao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对参数化向量优化问题的有效解映射S，发展了二阶灵敏度理论。在值-决策误差界(VDB)条件下，通过边际映射Φ的二阶信息推导出S的二阶Dini公式。首先建立抽象包含模型下的内外估计，得到S的二阶半可微性；随后针对结构化可行映射，在Robinson度量正则性、Ω和D的二阶正则性以及数据的方向二阶半可微性假设下，给出了DDH、DDΦ和DDS的显式公式，并推广至多面体不等式/等式系统，通过鲁棒多目标投资组合和电力市场DC调度模型进行说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数化向量优化问题的灵敏度分析多集中于有效值映射（边际映射）的一阶或二阶行为，而对有效解映射（决策映射）的二阶灵敏度研究不足。从有效值到有效决策的跃迁需要克服理论障碍，本文旨在建立从值空间到决策空间的二阶灵敏度理论框架，填补这一空白。

Method: 1) 引入值-决策误差界(VDB)条件，作为从边际映射二阶信息推导解映射二阶信息的桥梁；2) 在抽象包含模型x∈H(p)下，利用外估计和内估计建立S的二阶半可微性；3) 针对结构化可行映射H(p)={x∈Ω: g(p,x)∈D}，在Robinson度量正则性、Ω和D的二阶正则性、数据的方向二阶半可微性条件下，推导DDH、DDΦ和DDS的显式公式；4) 将框架特殊化至多面体系统，并应用于鲁棒多目标投资组合和电力市场DC调度模型。

Result: 建立了从边际映射二阶信息到有效解映射二阶信息的完整提升机制：在VDB条件下，边际映射Φ的二阶半导数值信息可提升为解映射S的二阶Dini公式；对结构化可行映射给出了切向导数和二阶切集的具体计算公式；通过多面体系统和两个应用实例验证了理论框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文成功发展了参数化向量优化问题有效解映射的二阶灵敏度理论，为从值空间灵敏度分析过渡到决策空间灵敏度分析提供了系统方法，并在多面体约束系统及实际电力市场、投资组合问题中展示了应用潜力，还可拓展至互补约束系统。

Abstract: We develop a second-order sensitivity theory for the efficient solution map \(S\) of a parametric vector optimization problem \(\min_C f(p,x)\) subject to \(x\in H(p)\). The main point is the passage from efficient values to efficient decisions. Under a value-to-decision error bound (VDB), second-order information for the marginal map \(Φ\) lifts to a second-order Dini formula for \(S\). We first work in the abstract inclusion model \(x\in H(p)\), where outer and inner estimates yield second-order semi-derivability of \(S\). We then specialize to structured feasible maps \(H(p)=\{x\inΩ:g(p,x)\in D\}\). Under Robinson metric regularity along \(Ω\), second-order regularity of \(Ω\) and \(D\), and directional second-order semi-derivability of the data, we obtain explicit formulas for \(\DD H\), \(\DDΦ\), and \(\DD S\). The framework is specialized to polyhedral inequality/equality systems and illustrated by a robust multi-objective portfolio model and a DC-dispatch model for electricity markets, with a brief discussion of complementarity-based extensions.

</details>


### [433] [Sharp $O(1/k)$ convergence rate for the Sinkhorn algorithm via a local analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28973)
*Guillaume Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了Sinkhorn算法在ℓ₁范数边际误差和联合相对熵上以O(1/k)速率收敛，该速率在渐进可缩放情形下是锐界的。证明基于检查熵正则化最优传输问题的二分图，并对最优传输计划中分配正质量的边与未分配正质量的边区别处理，从而得到具有锐界的局部收敛界，再通过作者先前工作（arXiv:2604.26265）中几乎锐界（差对数因子）的结果自举为全局界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sinkhorn算法是求解熵正则化最优传输问题的经典迭代算法，但其收敛速率的精确上界尚未完全确定。现有结果包含对数因子，需要确定是否存在更紧的O(1/k)锐界。

Method: 基于熵正则化最优传输问题对应的二分图结构，将边分为两类：最优传输计划中分配正质量的边和未分配正质量的边，分别进行分析。利用作者先前建立的几乎锐界结果（差对数因子），通过自举（bootstrapping）技术将局部锐界提升为全局锐界。

Result: Sinkhorn算法在ℓ₁范数边际误差和联合相对熵上以O(1/k)速率收敛，该速率是锐界的，在渐进可缩放情形下不可改进。

Conclusion: Sinkhorn算法收敛速率的确切上界为O(1/k)，填补了此前结果中对数因子的gap，确认了该速率在渐进可缩放情形下的最优性。

Abstract: We prove that the Sinkhorn algorithm converges at the rate of $O(1/k)$ in $\ell_1$-norm marginal error and in joint relative entropy, which is known to be sharp in the asymptotically scalable case. The proof is based on examining the bipartite graph associated to the entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, and treating differently the edges that are assigned a positive mass in the optimal transport plan vs. those that are not. This yields a local convergence bound with the sharp rate, which is bootstrapped into a global bound using the author's previous result in arXiv:2604.26265 where we showed an almost-sharp rate up to a logarithmic factor.

</details>


### [434] [Faster than Fast-LTS: Robust Regression and Outlier Detection with DC Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28974)
*Marah-Lisanne Thormann,Phan Tu Vuong,Alain B. Zemkoho,Tri-Dung Nguyen*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对最小修剪平方（LTS）鲁棒回归问题，将其重新表述为带 capped simplex 约束的凸函数差最小化问题，并提出渐进式增强 DC 算法（sBDCA）。理论上证明了算法在线性速率下的收敛性，实践中通过预条件矩阵实现单初始化的鲁棒性。实验表明，该方法比 Fast-LTS 快最多 3.25 倍，目标函数值降低高达 90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LTS 鲁棒回归的精确求解是组合优化问题，计算成本极高；现有启发式 Fast-LTS 需要大量初始点才能获得鲁棒结果，存在改进空间。

Method: 将 LTS 问题重新表述为带 capped simplex 约束的凸函数差（DC）最小化问题；提出渐进式增强 DC 算法（sBDCA）；通过 Łojasiewicz 性质建立收敛性理论；推导并集成问题特定的预条件矩阵以实现单初始化的鲁棒性。

Result: 数值实验表明，sBDCA 比 Fast-LTS 快最多 3.25 倍，目标函数值降低高达 90%，尤其在高维场景下表现突出。

Conclusion: sBDCA 是一种高效、鲁棒的 LTS 求解方法，从单一初始点即可获得良好性能，且所有代码开源，为 Python 鲁棒回归提供了实用指南。

Abstract: When datasets contain outliers, robust regression is a well-established alternative to Ordinary Least Squares. A commonly employed robust estimator is Least Trimmed Squares (LTS), which computes the regression coefficients from a subset of observations. Determining the exact solution corresponds to a combinatorial problem with prohibitive computational costs, even for instances of moderate dimension. Thus, the most prevalent approach in practice remains a heuristic known as Fast-LTS. Although the heuristic often performs effectively, certain elements of the approach remain open to improvement. In particular, its core procedure provides robust results only when initialized with a large number of starting points. To address the heuristic's limitations, this paper reformulates the LTS problem as a concave minimization problem subject to a capped simplex constraint, and proposes the successive Boosted Difference of Convex Functions Algorithm (sBDCA) as a solution method. Theoretically, we establish via the Łojasiewicz property that sBDCA converges to a local solution with a linear rate in the fastest case. To ensure robustness from a single initialization in practice, we derive and integrate a problem-specific preconditioning matrix into the algorithmic setup. Building on this theoretical foundation, we conduct numerical studies on various synthetic and real-world datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of sBDCA with preconditioning. Specifically, we show that our approach is up to 3.25 times faster than Fast-LTS and achieves up to 90% lower objective function values, particularly in high-dimensional settings. As all code is openly available, this paper further provides a practical guide to robust regression in Python.

</details>


### [435] [An Approximate Conjugate Subgradient Algorithm with Matrix Parameter for Derivative-Free Nonsmooth Optimization Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.29084)
*Morteza Kimiaei,Saman Babaie-Kafaki,Zohre Aminifard*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出了一种无导数矩阵共轭次梯度方法，用于求解局部Lipschitz函数的无约束非光滑优化问题。该方法仅使用函数值构造离散梯度，建立Goldstein次微分的有限采样模型，通过矩阵记忆校正、系数阻尼、对角缩放、有界角度校正和矩阵稳定性保障等机制增强鲁棒性，并采用两点线搜索过程。数值实验表明该方法在低中精度要求下鲁棒，且矩阵共轭次梯度变体在严格容差下最可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无导数优化方法在处理非光滑、高维问题时鲁棒性和效率不足，尤其缺乏有效利用次梯度信息且不依赖导数的方法。

Method: 1) 仅用函数值构造离散梯度，形成Goldstein次微分的有限采样模型；2) 计算采样离散梯度凸包的最小范数元素作为平稳性度量和下降方向参考向量；3) 引入矩阵记忆校正、系数阻尼、对角缩放、有界角度校正和矩阵稳定性保障；4) 采用带富集的两点线搜索过程。

Result: 在维度高达1000的非光滑测试问题上，两种变体在低中精度要求下表现鲁棒，矩阵共轭次梯度变体在严格容差下最为可靠。

Conclusion: 该方法在适当的离散梯度近似和线搜索采样一致性假设下，能生成满足保障下降性质的方向并计算近似Goldstein平稳点，是一种有效的非光滑无导数优化方法。

Abstract: We propose a derivative-free matrix conjugate-subgradient method for unconstrained nonsmooth optimization of locally Lipschitz functions. The method constructs discrete gradients using only function values and forms a finite sampled model of the Goldstein subdifferential.
